countries_cn.St. Vincent and the Grenadines: 圣文森特和格林纳丁斯

rows.measure: Through the national Action Plan for Energy and Climate, the Albanian government aims to install 200 to 300 charging stations by 2025 throughout the country.
rows.measure_cn: 通过国家能源与气候行动计划,阿尔巴尼亚政府计划到2025年在全国安装200至300个充电站。

rows.measure: Total VAT exemption for imports of EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 对进口电动汽车全额免征增值税。

rows.measure: 50% reduction of both import duty and vehicle tax for EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动汽车的进口关税和车辆税均减免50%。

rows.measure: Transition the government fleet to all-electric by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 到2035年将政府车队全面转为电动汽车。

rows.measure: Waiver for import duties for electric vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动汽车减免进口关税。

rows.measure: 2 500 jobs in battery manufacturing by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年在电池制造领域创造2500个就业岗位。

rows.measure: Buenos Aires: 30% low-emission cars in circulation by 2030, 100% by 2050.
rows.source: Government of the City of Buenos Aires
rows.measure_cn: 布宜诺斯艾利斯:到2030年在用低排放汽车占比达30%,到2050年达100%。

rows.measure: Buenos Aires: 50% ZEV buses by 2030, 100% by 2050.
rows.source: Government of the City of Buenos Aires
rows.measure_cn: 布宜诺斯艾利斯:到2030年零排放公交车占比达50%,到2050年达100%。

rows.measure: Ban on sale of new ICE vehicles from 2041.
rows.measure_cn: 自2041年起禁止销售新的燃油车。

rows.measure: Bill on the Promotion of Domestic Production of Electric and Hybrid Vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 关于促进电动和混合动力汽车本地生产的法案。

rows.measure: Decree 49/2025 cuts tariffs on electric and hybrid vehicles; allows 50 000 PHEV/EVs per year tariff-free; promotes modernisation and investment in local EV manufacturing, specifies electromobility as a long term goal.
rows.measure_cn: 第49/2025号法令削减电动和混合动力汽车关税;允许每年5万辆插电混动/电动汽车免关税进口;推动本地电动汽车制造的现代化与投资,将电动出行确立为长期目标。

rows.measure: Buenos Aires: From 1 January 2027, all new buses added to the transport network must be powered by clean energy electric or compressed natural gas. Current diesel units may continue operating until they reach the maximum permitted age limit.
rows.source: Government of the City of Buenos Aires
rows.measure_cn: 布宜诺斯艾利斯:自2027年1月1日起,所有新增入网公交车必须采用清洁能源(电动或压缩天然气)驱动。现有柴油车可继续运营至达到允许的最高使用年限。

rows.measure: Import tariffs lifted on some low-cost electric and hybrid vehicles. Up to 50 000 imports of low- cost EVs and hybrids will be exempt from tariffs for 1 year.
rows.measure_cn: 对部分低价电动和混合动力汽车取消进口关税。最多5万辆低价电动汽车和混合动力汽车将在1年内免征关税。

rows.measure: National Sustainable Transportation plan promotes electromobility and EV manufacturing, among other things.
rows.measure_cn: 国家可持续交通计划推动电动出行和电动汽车制造等。

rows.measure: Buenos Aires: The Buenos Aires City Government plans to expand its charging infrastructure for zero-emission vehicles with an additional 400 charging points by 2027. Furthermore, electric and hybrid cars will be exempted from registration tax and tolls till August 2026.
rows.source: Government of the City of Buenos Aires
rows.measure_cn: 布宜诺斯艾利斯:布宜诺斯艾利斯市政府计划扩展其零排放汽车充电基础设施,到2027年新增400个充电点。此外,电动和混合动力汽车在2026年8月前免征注册税和通行费。

rows.measure: The Sustainable Mobility Programme (Programa de Movilidad Sustentable) promotes micromobility and low-emissions transport for individuals and businesses; supports CNG and electric mobility; and provides financial incentives for vehicle and infrastructure investments.
rows.measure_cn: 可持续出行计划(Programa de Movilidad Sustentable)面向个人和企业推广微出行和低排放交通;支持压缩天然气和电动出行;并为车辆和基础设施投资提供资金激励。

rows.measure: Between 200 000 and 400 000 EVs deployed, as well as 10% of ICEs replaced with hybrids by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 到2050年部署20万至40万辆电动汽车,并将10%的燃油车替换为混合动力汽车。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission globally by 2040. The Eurasian Economic Commission's Council has agreed on duty-free EV imports until the end of 2025 until quotas are reached.
rows.measure_cn: 签署COP26零排放汽车宣言,致力于到2040年全球所有新销售的乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。欧亚经济委员会理事会已同意在配额用尽前实行电动汽车免关税进口直至2025年底。

rows.measure: Exempts electric vehicles from (VAT) under the Tax Code of the Republic of Armenia, applicable from 2019 through January 1 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 根据《亚美尼亚共和国税法》对电动汽车免征增值税,自2019年起适用至2026年1月1日。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Victoria: 50% of LDV fleet to be ZEV by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 签署《中重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录》(MOU),目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比30%,到2040年达100%。维多利亚州:到2030年轻型车队的50%为零排放汽车。

rows.measure: Queensland: 50% of new passenger vehicle sales to be zero-emissions by 2030, moving to 100% by 2036.
rows.measure_cn: 昆士兰州:到2030年新乘用车销量的50%为零排放,到2036年提升至100%。

rows.measure: Australian Capital Territory : 80-90% of new car sales to be ZEVs by 2030 and all new LDVs to be ZEVs by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 澳大利亚首都领地:到2030年新车销量的80%-90%为零排放汽车,到2035年所有新轻型车辆为零排放汽车。

rows.measure: Victoria: All new public buses to be ZEV by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 维多利亚州:到2025年所有新公共巴士为零排放汽车。

rows.measure: Electric Car Discount excludes eligible electric cars and associated car expenses from fringe benefits tax.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车折扣政策将符合条件的电动汽车及相关用车费用排除在附加福利税之外。

rows.measure: Australian Capital Territory : Lower registration fees for lower-emissions vehicles and low- interest loans. Victoria: Fully decarbonised transport sector by 2045.
rows.measure_cn: 澳大利亚首都领地:对低排放车辆降低注册费并提供低息贷款。维多利亚州:到2045年交通运输部门完全脱碳。

rows.measure: Driving the Nation Fund is supporting the rollout of EV charging infrastructure across Australia through several initiatives.
rows.measure_cn: “驱动国家基金”通过多项举措支持在澳大利亚全境部署电动汽车充电基础设施。

rows.measure: New South Wales: Increase EV sales to 52% by 2030–31 and help New South Wales achieve net zero emissions by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 新南威尔士州:到2030-31年将电动汽车销量提升至52%,助力新南威尔士州在2050年实现净零排放。

rows.measure: National Battery Strategy that aims to support the development of the battery manufacturing industry in Australia by 2035, making Australia a globally competitive producer of batteries and battery materials.
rows.measure_cn: 国家电池战略,旨在到2035年支持澳大利亚电池制造业发展,使澳大利亚成为具有全球竞争力的电池及电池材料生产国。

rows.measure: National Electric Vehicle Strategy which includes details of state-level targets and incentives, with aim to increase the supply of affordable and accessible EVs, establish the resources, systems and infrastructure to enable rapid EV uptake, and encourage increased EV demand
rows.measure_cn: 国家电动汽车战略,包含州级目标和激励措施的细节,旨在增加经济实惠且易于获取的电动汽车供给,建立支撑电动汽车快速普及所需的资源、系统和基础设施,并刺激电动汽车需求增长。

rows.measure: Transport and Infrastructure Net Zero Roadmap and Action Plan sets out how the uptake of cleaner cars, active and public transport, and solutions for aviation, maritime, freight, rail and roads will transform the sector, and help reach net zero emissions by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 《交通与基础设施净零路线图及行动计划》阐明了如何推动清洁汽车、慢行与公共交通的普及,以及航空、海运、货运、铁路和公路的解决方案如何变革该部门,助力到2050年实现净零排放。

rows.measure: South Australia: New metropolitan taxis to be 100% EVs by 2030, and government and ride share fleets to be 100% EVs by 2030. All new passenger vehicles sold in South Australia to be fully electric by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 南澳大利亚州:到2030年新增大都市出租车100%为电动汽车,政府及网约车车队到2030年100%为电动汽车。到2035年在南澳大利亚州销售的所有新乘用车均为纯电动。

rows.measure: New Vehicle Efficiency Standard will reduce CO2 from new passenger vehicles by 60% between 2025 and 2029, and by 50% for light commercial vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 新车能效标准将使新乘用车在2025年至2029年间二氧化碳排放降低60%,轻型商用车降低50%。

rows.type_raw: Announced target Announced target Announced target
rows.measure: The pledge goal is 100% zero-emission LDV acquisitions of civil government owned and operated fleet, with aspirations for 100% zero-emission M/HDV acquisitions, by no later than 2035. Australia also specifically aims for 75% of new government passenger vehicles to be low emission by 2025. New South Wales: Transition the state's 8 000 buses to ZEVs, starting with Greater Sydney by 2035, Outer Metropolitan regions by 2040, and Regional New South Wales by 2047. Tasmania: Transition the Tasmanian Government fleet to 100% EVs by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 承诺目标为最迟到2035年实现政府所有及运营的轻型车辆采购100%零排放,并力争中重型车辆采购100%零排放。澳大利亚还明确目标为到2025年75%的政府新乘用车为低排放。新南威尔士州:将该州8000辆公交车转为零排放汽车,从大悉尼地区(2035年)开始,外大都市区(2040年),新南威尔士州偏远地区(2047年)。塔斯马尼亚州:到2030年将塔斯马尼亚政府车队100%转为电动汽车。

rows.measure: 100% share of ZEVs in new bus sales by 2032.
rows.measure_cn: 到2032年新公交车销量中零排放汽车占比达100%。

rows.measure: 100% share of ZEVs in new car, light commercial, and two-wheeler sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年新乘用车、轻型商用车和两轮车销量中零排放汽车占比达100%。

rows.measure: 100% share of ZEVs in new heavy goods vehicle sales (above 18 tonnes) by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 到2035年新重型货车(18吨以上)销量中零排放汽车占比达100%。

rows.measure: 100% share of ZEVs in new heavy goods vehicle sales (under 18 tonnes) by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年新重型货车(18吨以下)销量中零排放汽车占比达100%。

rows.measure: EUR 365 million budget to subsidise emission-free commercial vehicles and infrastructure. Covers 80% of additional costs for the purchase of ZEVs, 80% of the costs of conversion to zero- emission powertrain, 40% of investment costs for infrastucture.
rows.measure_cn: 拨款3.65亿欧元补贴零排放商用车及基础设施。涵盖购置零排放汽车额外成本的80%、改装为零排放动力系统成本的80%、基础设施投资成本的40%。

rows.measure: EVs are exempt from standard registration tax, consumption tax, motor-related insurance tax, and benefit-in-kind tax. Company vehicle EVs are tax deductible and VAT exempt.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车免征标准注册税、消费税、车辆相关保险税和实物福利税。公司用电动汽车可抵扣税款并免征增值税。

rows.measure: Necessary infrastructure for all types of ZEV road transport to be in place by no later than 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 最迟到2035年建成支持所有类型零排放道路运输车辆所需的基础设施。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Expand and modernise the public transportation networks, including buses, trains, and metro; Incentivise behavioural change toward increased usage of public transportation and micro- mobility; Increase the EV share in passenger car, bus, and truck fleets; Support the adoption of EVs through incentive programmes.
rows.measure_cn: 签署《中重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录》(MOU),目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比30%,到2040年达100%。签署COP26零排放汽车宣言,致力于在领先市场最迟到2035年所有新销售乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。扩展并升级公共交通网络,包括公交车、火车和地铁;激励行为转变,提高公共交通和微出行的使用率;提高乘用车、公交车和卡车保有量中电动汽车的占比;通过激励计划支持电动汽车的普及。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. The import and sale of second and third-level electric chargers for electric vehicles are exempt from VAT.
rows.measure_cn: 签署COP26零排放汽车宣言,致力于在领先市场最迟到2035年所有新销售乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。电动汽车二级和三级充电器的进口和销售免征增值税。

rows.measure: 10 year tax holiday for local EV manufacturing and assembly, various incentives.
rows.measure_cn: 对本地电动汽车制造和组装给予10年免税期及各类激励。

rows.measure: 30% of new registrations to be electric by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年新注册车辆中电动汽车占比达30%。

rows.measure: 40% of private cars and 10% of buses and trucks will be EVs by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 到2050年40%的私家车以及10%的公交车和卡车为电动汽车。

rows.measure: Defines requirements and procedures for EVSE installation and operation.
rows.measure_cn: 界定电动汽车充电设施安装和运营的要求与流程。

rows.measure: By 2035, Belarus plans to have 35 super-fast electric charging stations, as outlined in the Resolution of the Council of Ministers No. 816, dated 5 November 2024.
rows.measure_cn: 根据2024年11月5日第816号部长会议决议,白俄罗斯计划到2035年建成35个超快速电动充电站。

rows.measure: Cost deductions for EVSE investments from 100% in 2020 decreasing gradually to 30% in 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 对充电设施投资给予成本抵扣,从2020年的100%逐步降至2025年的30%。

rows.measure: Resolution No. 166 (March 2024) to: Regulate the establishment of domestic EV manufacturing companies.
rows.measure_cn: 第166号决议(2024年3月):规范国内电动汽车制造企业的设立。

rows.measure: The goal set for the next 5 years is 300 000 EVs. This figure is equivalent to 10% of the automobile traffic. According to the plans, if the trend continues, at least 8 000 to 10 000 electric charging stations will be available to ensure comfortable recharging, say Belarusneft.
rows.measure_cn: 未来5年的目标是30万辆电动汽车,相当于汽车交通量的10%。白俄罗斯石油公司表示,根据规划,若该趋势持续,届时将提供至少8000至10000个电动充电站以确保便捷充电。

rows.measure: VAT exemptions for import of EVs; VAT exemption on import of goods for EV manufacturing.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车进口免征增值税;电动汽车制造用商品进口免征增值税。

rows.measure: The Eurasian Economic Commission's Council has agreed on duty-free EV imports until the end of 2025 until quotas are reached.
rows.measure_cn: 欧亚经济委员会理事会已同意在配额用尽前实行电动汽车免关税进口直至2025年底。

rows.measure: Amends the national incentive framework for EVs under Presidential Decree No. 428 of 11 December 2025, superseding the 2020 decree, and provides taxation incentives for electric LDVs applicable for the 2025–2028 period.
rows.measure_cn: 根据2025年12月11日第428号总统令修订电动汽车国家激励框架,取代2020年法令,并为电动轻型车辆提供适用于2025-2028年期间的税收激励。

rows.measure: 100% of the purchase value of a company BEV is deducted from corporate taxable income.
rows.measure_cn: 公司纯电动汽车购置价值的100%可从企业应税收入中抵扣。

rows.measure: Flanders: 20% of sales to be ZEV by 2025, and 50% BEV or FCEV sales and 20% PHEV in 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 佛兰德斯:到2025年零排放汽车销量占比达20%,到2030年纯电动或燃料电池汽车销量占比达50%、插电混动占比达20%。

rows.measure: Flanders: 50% of all new purchases of non-urban buses, and at least 5% of trucks, will be zero- emission or low-carbon by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 佛兰德斯:到2030年所有新购城际公交车的50%以及至少5%的卡车为零排放或低碳车辆。

rows.measure: Flanders: All urban public transport will be HEV, BEV, or FCEV by 2025, with all buses emission free by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 佛兰德斯:到2025年所有城市公共交通为混合动力、纯电动或燃料电池汽车,到2035年所有公交车实现零排放。

rows.measure: Flanders: At least 30% of new LCVs will be zero-emissions by 2030, and encouraging emission- free distribution from 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 佛兰德斯:到2030年至少30%的新轻型商用车为零排放,并从2025年起鼓励零排放配送。

rows.measure: Flanders: At least 5% of all trucks sales will be zero-emission or low-carbon by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 佛兰德斯:到2030年所有卡车销量的至少5%为零排放或低碳车辆。

rows.measure: Wallonia and Brussels : EVs are eligible for the lowest rate of annual ownership tax, HEVs are taxed in the same way as ICEs (engine size and emissions). Flanders: EVs are indefinitely exempt from both annual road and registration tax (PHEV and NG exemption ended in 2020). Tax relief via income tax of 15% also applies to the purchase of electric motorbikes, tricycles, and quadricycles.
rows.measure_cn: 瓦隆和布鲁塞尔:电动汽车适用最低档年度持有税,混合动力汽车与燃油车同等计税(按发动机排量和排放)。佛兰德斯:电动汽车无限期免征年度道路税和注册税(插电混动和天然气车的豁免已于2020年结束)。购买电动摩托车、三轮车和四轮车还可享受15%的所得税减免。

rows.measure: Wallonia: Progressively ban the use of older vehicles (Euro 1, 2, 3 ban delayed to 2025, Euro 4 in 2026, Euro 5 in 2028, Euro 6 in 2030), and allow for the introduction of more restrictive LEZs.
rows.measure_cn: 瓦隆:逐步禁止使用旧车(欧1、欧2、欧3禁令推迟至2025年,欧4于2026年,欧5于2028年,欧6于2030年),并允许引入更严格的低排放区。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Flanders: Tax relief for company vehicles is tied to emissions, with 0g CO2 vehicles qualifying for up to 120% relief. Electricity costs are deductible at 75%.
rows.measure_cn: 签署《中重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录》(MOU),目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比30%,到2040年达100%。签署COP26零排放汽车宣言,致力于在领先市场最迟到2035年所有新销售乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。佛兰德斯:公司车辆的税收减免与排放挂钩,0g二氧化碳车辆可享受最高120%的减免。电费可抵扣75%。

rows.measure: Tax breaks for the purchase of new vehicles in 2025. Introduces preferential tax treatment for electric LDVs under the Green Tax Rules, extended in 2024.
rows.measure_cn: 2025年对购买新车给予税收减免。根据《绿色税收规则》对电动轻型车辆引入优惠税收待遇,并于2024年延长。

rows.measure: Annual 10% growth in the share of EVs in the Bolivian public transportation fleet.
rows.measure_cn: 玻利维亚公共交通车队中电动汽车占比每年增长10%。

rows.measure: Tax incentives and financial incentives for the manufacturing, assembly, import, and purchase of EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动汽车的制造、组装、进口和购买给予税收激励和资金激励。

rows.measure: Subsidies for the purchase of electric and hybrid cars to individuals in 2022.
rows.measure_cn: 2022年向个人提供购买电动和混合动力汽车的补贴。

rows.measure: Deputies Bill No. 2156/2021 that aims to provide guidelines for the National Electric Mobility Policy.
rows.measure_cn: 第2156/2021号众议员法案,旨在为国家电动出行政策提供指导方针。

rows.measure: Federal Bill PL 497/2025 proposes income-tax deductions for public or shared EV chargers
rows.measure_cn: 联邦法案PL 497/2025提议对公共或共享电动汽车充电器给予所得税抵扣。

rows.measure: National Green Mobility and Innovation Program ("MOVER"), Provisional Measure 1,205/2023 establishes new guidelines for the local automotive sector, including fleet sustainability requirements and incentives for the production of new technologies. It also outlines financial incentives and support, such as, credits and fiscal incentives (up to R$ 19.3 billion in financial credits between 2024 and 2028) and a National Fund for Industrial Development.
rows.measure_cn: 国家绿色出行与创新计划(“MOVER”),临时措施1205/2023为本地汽车行业制定新的指导方针,包括车队可持续性要求和新技术生产激励。其还规定了资金激励与支持,如信贷和财政激励(2024年至2028年间最高193亿雷亚尔的资金信贷)以及国家工业发展基金。

rows.measure: PL 158/2025 proposes ensuring that apartment owners can install private EV chargers in their parking spaces, provided technical standards are followed.
rows.measure_cn: PL 158/2025提议确保公寓业主在符合技术标准的前提下可在其停车位安装私人电动汽车充电器。

rows.measure: Resolution no. 532/2023 from the Executive Committee of the Foreign Chamber of Commerce establishes the gradual return of import tax on electric, hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 外贸商会执行委员会第532/2023号决议规定对电动、混合动力和插电混动汽车逐步恢复征收进口税。

rows.measure: Senate Bill No. 403/2022 that aims to grant exemption from Import Tax for electric and hybrid vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 第403/2022号参议院法案,旨在对电动和混合动力汽车给予进口税豁免。

rows.measure: São Paulo: The city of São Paulo has mandated that new buildings prepare and plan for the charging infrastructure required for electric vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 圣保罗:圣保罗市已强制要求新建建筑为电动汽车所需的充电基础设施做好准备和规划。

rows.measure: Mission 3 of the Nova Indústria Brasil programme. This industrial policy sets specific targets for six missions, including Mission 3, which focuses on Sustainable Mobility. The priority areas of this mission include the advancement of electromobility and the development of a national battery supply chain for electric vehicles
rows.measure_cn: “新巴西工业”(Nova Indústria Brasil)计划的使命3。该产业政策为六项使命设定了具体目标,其中使命3聚焦可持续出行。该使命的优先领域包括推进电动出行和发展电动汽车国家电池供应链。

rows.measure: Build 10 000 charging stations to facilitate at least 30 000 EVs by 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 到2026年建成10000个充电站,以满足至少30000辆电动汽车的需求。

rows.measure: Registration and annual circulation tax exemption for electric cars, motorbikes, and mopeds.
rows.measure_cn: 电动乘用车、摩托车和轻便摩托车免征注册税和年度流通税。

rows.measure: 100% EVs in government LDV stock by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年政府轻型车辆保有量100%为电动汽车。

rows.measure: 15% share of EVs in medium truck sales by 2025, 35% by 2030 and 100% by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年中型卡车销量中电动汽车占比达15%,2030年达35%,2035年达100%。

rows.measure: 25% share of EVs in heavy truck sales by 2030 and 100% by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年重型卡车销量中电动汽车占比达25%,2035年达100%。

rows.measure: 35% share of passenger LDV sales to be EVs by 2025, 70% by 2030 and 100% by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年乘用轻型车辆销量中电动汽车占比达35%,2030年达70%,2035年达100%。

rows.measure: 50% share of EVs in urban bus sales by 2025, 75% by 2030 and 100% by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年城市公交车销量中电动汽车占比达50%,2030年达75%,2040年达100%。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. 40% of cars and urban buses to be EVs by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 签署《中重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录》(MOU),目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比30%,到2040年达100%。签署COP26零排放汽车宣言,致力于在领先市场最迟到2035年所有新销售乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。到2050年40%的乘用车和城市公交车为电动汽车。

rows.measure: 70% of motorcycle stock to be EVs by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 到2050年70%的摩托车保有量为电动汽车。

rows.measure: Registration of 30 000 electric vehicles by 2030 including 25 000 private cars and 5 000 commercial vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年注册30000辆电动汽车,其中包括25000辆私家车和5000辆商用车。

rows.measure: Registration of 720 000 electric two-wheelers and 20 000 three-wheelers by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年注册720000辆电动两轮车和20000辆三轮车。

rows.measure: Excise duties on EVs cut from 12.5% to 0% in Article 131 bis of the General Tax Code in Cameroon.
rows.measure_cn: 根据喀麦隆《一般税法》第131条之二,电动汽车消费税从12.5%降至0%。

rows.measure: British Columbia: 10 000 public EV charging stations by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 不列颠哥伦比亚省:到2030年建成10000个公共电动汽车充电站。

rows.measure: Quebec: 100% of government cars, SUVs, vans and minivans and 25% of its pickup trucks to be electrified by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 魁北克省:到2030年100%的政府轿车、SUV、厢式车和小型厢式车以及25%的皮卡实现电动化。

rows.measure: Quebec: 40% of taxis to be electric by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 魁北克省:到2030年40%的出租车为电动。

rows.measure: British Columbia: Accelerated (ahead of national ambition) ZEV targets for LDV sales of 26% by 2026, 90% by 2030 and 100% by 2035. However, the Province is in the process of amending the ZEV Act to reduce the 2035 sales target from 100% to 75%, along with unspecified changes to interim targets. The amendments are expected to become offical in Q3 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 不列颠哥伦比亚省:加速(超前于国家目标)的零排放汽车目标,轻型车辆销量占比到2026年达26%,2030年达90%,2035年达100%。然而,该省正在修订《零排放汽车法》,拟将2035年销量目标从100%下调至75%,并对中期目标作出未明确的调整。修订预计于2026年第三季度正式生效。

rows.measure: Quebec: All new public/government funded buses will be electric by 2025, and 55% of city buses and 65% of school buses by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 魁北克省:到2025年所有新的公共/政府资助公交车为电动,到2030年55%的城市公交车和65%的校车为电动。

rows.measure: Canadian CO2 emissions standards are aligned with the US Phase 2 standard, targeting new heavy duty vehicle CO2 emissions reductions of 5-27% in model year 2027 (depending on vehicle category and weight) compared to 2017.
rows.measure_cn: 加拿大的二氧化碳排放标准与美国第二阶段标准一致,目标是2027车型年新重型车辆二氧化碳排放较2017年减少5%-27%(取决于车辆类别和重量)。

rows.measure: Charging and Hydrogen Refuelling Infrastructure Initiative provides financing to the the private sector to build out public fast chargers or hydrogen refuelling infrastructure.
rows.measure_cn: 充电和加氢基础设施倡议为私营部门建设公共快速充电桩或加氢基础设施提供融资。

rows.measure: British Columbia: CleanBC Go Electric rebates are available for electric bus and commercial vehicle purchases.
rows.measure_cn: 不列颠哥伦比亚省:CleanBC Go Electric返利适用于电动公交车和商用车的购买。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase or lease of BEV, FCEV, or PHEV coaches and medium- and heavy- duty trucks (iMHZEV programme).
rows.measure_cn: 为购买或租赁纯电动、燃料电池或插电混动客车及中重型卡车提供补助(iMHZEV计划)。

rows.measure: Yukon: Homeowners can receive grants of 50%, businesses 75%, and municipalities/first nations 90% per charger installed. Prince Edward Island: Incentives towards the purchase or lease of a BEV or PHEV and voucher towards the cost of a charger installation. Quebec: Increase the number of fast-chargers to 2 500 by 2030, and up to 4 500 standard chargers.
rows.measure_cn: 育空地区:房主每安装一个充电器可获50%补助,企业75%,市政/原住民部落90%。爱德华王子岛:购买或租赁纯电动或插电混动汽车的激励以及充电器安装费用的代金券。魁北克省:到2030年将快速充电桩数量增至2500个,标准充电桩增至最多4500个。

rows.measure: Yukon: Rebate towards the purchase of a BEV or PHEV with more than 50km of electric range, or a lower amount for a PHEV with less than 50km range. Newfoundland and Labrador: Rebate towards the purchase or lease of a BEV, lower amount for a PHEV, which can be combined with federal incentives.
rows.measure_cn: 育空地区:对购买电动续航超过50公里的纯电动或插电混动汽车给予返利,续航低于50公里的插电混动给予较低金额。纽芬兰与拉布拉多省:对购买或租赁纯电动汽车给予返利,插电混动金额较低,可与联邦激励叠加。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Quebec: Target of 6 700 public fast-charging and 110 000 level 2 public charging stations by 2030 supported by an increased budget and amendments to building standards.
rows.measure_cn: 签署《中重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录》(MOU),目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比30%,到2040年达100%。签署COP26零排放汽车宣言,致力于在领先市场最迟到2035年所有新销售乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。魁北克省:在增加预算和修订建筑标准的支持下,到2030年建成6700个公共快速充电站和110000个二级公共充电站。

rows.measure: The Government of Canada announced the intent to repeal the EV Availability Standard and to introduce stengthened GHG emissions standards to put Canada on a path to achieve 75% EV sales by 2035 and 90% EV sales by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 加拿大政府宣布拟废除电动汽车供应标准,并引入强化的温室气体排放标准,使加拿大走上到2035年实现75%电动汽车销量、到2040年实现90%电动汽车销量的路径。

rows.measure: The Government of Canada announced the launch of a 5-year EV Affordability Program that provides purchase or lease incentives up to CAD 5 000 for BEVs and FCEVs, and up to CAD 2 500 for PHEVs, though incentive levels decline over time.
rows.measure_cn: 加拿大政府宣布启动为期5年的电动汽车可负担计划,为纯电动和燃料电池汽车提供最高5000加元、为插电混动提供最高2500加元的购买或租赁激励,但激励水平随时间递减。

rows.measure: Quebec: The Green Transportation Program offers financial assistance for the acquisition and installation of direct current (DC) fast-charging stations for electric heavy-duty vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 魁北克省:绿色交通计划为电动重型车辆的直流(DC)快速充电站的购置和安装提供资金援助。

rows.measure: Nova Scotia: The Medium- and Heavy-Duty Zero Emissions Vehicle Rebate Program provides rebates for the purchase or lease of qualifying zero-emission medium- and heavy-duty vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 新斯科舍省:中重型零排放汽车返利计划为购买或租赁符合条件的零排放中重型车辆提供返利。

rows.measure: The pledge goal is 100% zero-emission LDV acquisitions of civil government owned and operated fleet, with aspirations for 100% zero-emission M/HDV acquisitions, by no later than 2035. Canada also specifically aims for 75% of all government LDV purchases to be ZEVs or hybrid, with the objective that the LDV fleet is 100% ZEV by 2030. The Zero Emission Vehicle Infrastructure Program contributes up to 50% of the project cost (75% for indigenous businesses and communities) when installing charging infrastructure.
rows.measure_cn: 承诺目标为最迟到2035年实现政府所有及运营的轻型车辆采购100%零排放,并力争中重型车辆采购100%零排放。加拿大还明确目标为75%的政府轻型车辆采购为零排放汽车或混合动力,目标是到2030年轻型车队100%为零排放汽车。零排放汽车基础设施计划在安装充电基础设施时承担最高50%的项目成本(原住民企业和社区为75%)。

rows.measure: Quebec: ZEV targets adjusted such that the target of 100% zero-emission vehicles by 2035 is replaced by a target of 90%, combining EVs and PHEVs.
rows.measure_cn: 魁北克省:零排放汽车目标调整,将2035年100%零排放汽车的目标替换为90%(纯电动与插电混动合计)的目标。

rows.measure: 100% of sales of heavy mobile machinery will be zero-emissions by 2035, 100% of sales of all mobile machinery (heavy and light) by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 智利:到2035年重型移动机械销量100%为零排放,到2040年所有移动机械(重型和轻型)销量100%为零排放。

rows.measure: 100% of sales of M/HDVs will be zero-emissions by 2045.
rows.measure_cn: 到2045年中重型车辆销量100%为零排放。

rows.measure: 100% of sales of public transport vehicles will be zero-emissions by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 到2035年公共交通车辆销量100%为零排放。

rows.measure: 100% of the public transport fleet (buses + taxis) will be zero-emissions by 2040, ensuring the necessary infrastructure is in place to achieve this.
rows.measure_cn: 到2040年公共交通车队(公交车+出租车)100%为零排放,并确保配备实现该目标所需的基础设施。

rows.measure: 60% of the vehicle fleet to be ZEVs by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 到2050年60%的车队为零排放汽车。

rows.measure: Accelerated tax depreciation of electric, hybrid, and zero emissions vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动、混合动力和零排放车辆实行加速税收折旧。

rows.measure: Energy efficiency law which promotes the importation of BEVs and PHEVs. Entered into force in 2024, requiring fleet average efficiency of 5.3Lge/100km for the period 2024-26. 2027–2029: An improvement to 22.8 km/lge. 2030: A further increase to 28.9 km/lge.
rows.measure_cn: 能效法推动纯电动和插电混动汽车的进口。于2024年生效,要求2024-26年期间车队平均能效为5.3升汽油当量/100公里。2027-2029年:提升至22.8公里/升汽油当量。2030年:进一步提高至28.9公里/升汽油当量。

rows.measure: Light-duty vehicles are set to increase the fuel economy per litre of gasoline equivalent (lge) from a baseline in 2020 of 14.9 km/lge to 18.8 km/lge from 2024 to 2026, increasing to 22.8 km/lge from 2027 to 2029, and to 28.9 km/lge in 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 轻型车辆的每升汽油当量(lge)燃油经济性将从2020年基线14.9公里/升汽油当量,在2024至2026年提高至18.8公里/升汽油当量,2027至2029年增至22.8公里/升汽油当量,2030年达28.9公里/升汽油当量。

rows.measure: National public charging infrastructure plan targeting charging stations along interurban routes at most every 100km apart.
rows.measure_cn: 国家公共充电基础设施计划,目标为沿城际线路最多每100公里设置一处充电站。

rows.measure: Roadmap for promoting electromobility including near-term actions on charging, public transport, awareness and regulation.
rows.measure_cn: 推广电动出行的路线图,包括充电、公共交通、宣传和监管方面的近期行动。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Tax reductions for EVs during the first 8 years after car registration (increasing gradually from 0% tax to 100%).
rows.measure_cn: 签署《中重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录》(MOU),目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比30%,到2040年达100%。签署COP26零排放汽车宣言,致力于在领先市场最迟到2035年所有新销售乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。电动汽车在车辆注册后的前8年享受税收减免(从0%税率逐步增至100%)。

rows.measure: The 2023 bidding process (and subsequent 2025 tenders) now jointly awards operation and fleet provision, with a mandatory requirement for 100% of new vehicles to be electric.
rows.measure_cn: 2023年招标流程(及随后的2025年招标)现将运营与车队提供联合授予,并强制要求100%的新车为电动。

rows.measure: 11 pilot cities to demonstrate battery swapping technology, ultimately aiming to promote more than 100 000 battery swapping-enabled EVs, and more than 1 000 battery swapping stations in the demonstration period.
rows.source: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
rows.measure_cn: 11个试点城市示范换电技术,最终目标是在示范期内推广超过100000辆支持换电的电动汽车和超过1000座换电站。

rows.measure: Beijing: 2 million NEVs on the road by 2025. Proportion of new vehicle sales being new energy and clean energy-powered transport to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 北京:到2025年道路上有200万辆新能源汽车。到2030年新车销量中新能源和清洁能源动力交通工具占比达约40%(碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: A package of 18 measures across six pillars to support international trade of NEVs, such as the promotion of overseas R&D co-operation, enhancing overseas compliance capabilities, and stengthening after-sales capabilities.
rows.measure_cn: 围绕六大支柱推出18项措施支持新能源汽车国际贸易,如推动海外研发合作、增强海外合规能力、加强售后能力等。

rows.measure: Shanghai: Aims for carbon from urban transportation to peak by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking in the Transport Sector).
rows.measure_cn: 上海:目标为到2030年城市交通碳排放达峰(交通运输领域碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: Anhui: Aims for road transport oil consumption to peak before 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking for the Industry Sector).
rows.measure_cn: 安徽:目标为道路交通石油消费于2030年前达峰(工业领域碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: Shandong: Aims for road transport oil consumption to peak before 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 山东:目标为道路交通石油消费于2030年前达峰(碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: Shanghai: BEVs to make up more than 50% of new personal vehicle purchases by 2025 and more than 40% of car stock by 2035 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 上海:到2025年纯电动汽车占新增个人购车的50%以上,到2035年占汽车保有量的40%以上(碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: By 2025, establish a preliminary interactive network between vehicles and the grids and fully implement peak and valley (peak/off-peak) pricing mechanism for EV charging. In the 5 pilot cities, by 2025, aim to have 60% of annual EV charging electricity concentrated during valley price time, and 80% of private EV charging pile utilisation concentrated during valley price time. By 2030, fully establish the interactive network between vehicles and the grids, aiming to provide flexibility for the electricity system at 10 GW level.
rows.source: China's National Development and Reform Commission
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年初步建成车网互动网络并全面实施电动汽车充电峰谷分时电价机制。在5个试点城市,到2025年力争60%的年度电动汽车充电电量集中在谷价时段,80%的私人电动汽车充电桩利用率集中在谷价时段。到2030年全面建成车网互动网络,力争为电力系统提供10吉瓦级的灵活性。

rows.measure: China's Action Plan for Reaching Carbon Dioxide Peak Before 2030: Proportion of new energy and clean energy-powered vehicle sales (for transport) to reach around 40% by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 中国2030年前碳达峰行动方案:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力(交通用)汽车销量占比达约40%。

rows.measure: Hainan: End sales of petrol or diesel vehicles by 2030; 100% NEVs in vehicle sales (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 海南:到2030年停止销售汽油或柴油车;车辆销量中新能源汽车占比100%(碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: Hainan: End the sale of petrol and diesel vehicles by 2030. From 2030, all vehicle sales will be either NEVs or natural gas vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 海南:到2030年停止销售汽油和柴油车。自2030年起,所有车辆销量均为新能源汽车或天然气汽车。

rows.measure: Establish a high-quality charging infrastructure system by 2030, ensuring city-level full coverage, highway-level linear coverage, and spotted-coverage of rural areas.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年建成高质量充电基础设施体系,确保城市级全覆盖、高速公路级线状覆盖以及农村地区点状覆盖。

rows.measure: Grants for the purchase of NEVs (passenger cars), with extra benefits in case for scrapping old ICEVs (registered before 2013 and 2015, in case of gasoline and diesel, respectively) and NEVs (registered before 2019). For NEVs the scrapping subsidy amounts to 12% of the purchase price, capped at RMB 20 000. For gasoline cars with 2.0-liter or smaller engines, the subsidy is 10% of the purchase price, capped at RMB 15 000. For trade-in rather than scrapping the vehicle subsidies for NEVs are 8% (capped at RMB 15 000), and for ICEVs subsidy is 6% (capped at RMB 13 000)
rows.source: China, National Development and Reform Commission
rows.measure_cn: 对购买新能源汽车(乘用车)给予补贴,对报废旧燃油车(汽油车2013年前注册、柴油车2015年前注册)和旧新能源汽车(2019年前注册)给予额外优惠。报废情形下,新能源汽车补贴为购车价的12%,每辆新能源乘用车上限为2万元人民币。对2.0升及以下排量的汽油车,补贴为购车价的10%,上限为1.5万元人民币。置换(而非报废)情形下,新能源汽车补贴为8%(上限1.5万元人民币),燃油车补贴为6%(上限1.3万元人民币)。

rows.measure: Jilin: Increase the proportion of clean transportation, encourage companies to replace freight vehicles with NEVs and to promote the elimination of old diesel vehicles, build charging infrastructure in highway service areas, logistical hubs and hubs for freight vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 吉林:提高清洁交通占比,鼓励企业以新能源汽车替换货运车辆并推动淘汰旧柴油车,在高速公路服务区、物流枢纽和货运车辆枢纽建设充电基础设施。

rows.measure: Inner-Mongolia: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region aims for the proportion of new energy and clean energy-powered transport vehicles (excluding motorbikes) to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 内蒙古:内蒙古自治区目标为到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力交通车辆(不含摩托车)占比达约40%(碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: NEV exemption from vehicle purchase tax extended to the end of 2025, and a reduction of NEV vehicle purchase tax by 50%, with the tax reduction amount not exceeding 15,000 yuan per new energy passenger vehicle, between 2026 - 2027. At the start of 2026 the threshold to apply for the (reduced) exemption was raised; BEVs energy consumption limits are 11% lower, while PHEVs need to have a minimum electric range of 100 km (previous 43 km)
rows.measure_cn: 新能源汽车免征车辆购置税延长至2025年底,2026-2027年新能源汽车车辆购置税减半,减税额每辆新能源乘用车不超过15000元。2026年初,申请(减免)免税的门槛提高;纯电动汽车能耗限值降低11%,插电混动需具备至少100公里的纯电续航(此前为43公里)。

rows.measure: NEV sales in key air pollution control regions to account for about 50% of new vehicle sales by 2030 (Synergetic Reduction of Pollution and Carbon Emission).
rows.source: China, Ministry of Ecology and Environment
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年重点大气污染防治区域新能源汽车销量约占新车销量的50%(减污降碳协同)。

rows.measure: NEV sales to account for 60% of new vehicle sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年新能源汽车销量占新车销量的60%。

rows.measure: NEV sales to account for 45% of new vehicle sales by 2027.
rows.measure_cn: 到2027年新能源汽车销量占新车销量的45%。

rows.measure: Ningxia: NEV sales to account for around 20% of total new car sales by 2025, new energy and clean energy-powered vehicle sales to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 宁夏:到2025年新能源汽车销量约占新车总销量的20%,到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力汽车销量占比达约40%(碳达峰方案)。

rows.measure: Tianjin: NEV sales to account for around 25% of total new car sales by 2025 and around 50% of total new car sales by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 天津:到2025年新能源汽车销量约占新车总销量的25%,到2030年约占50%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: New energy transport guidelines released by the government. By 2027 the target for the proportion of electricity in the transport sector's final energy consumption is to reach 10%, while the installed capacity of non-fossil energy power generation along major transport infrastructure will exceed 5 million kilowatts. Meanwhile, the production capacity of green fuels for the transport sector will be significantly enhanced.
rows.measure_cn: 政府发布新能源交通指导意见。到2027年,电力在交通运输领域终端能源消费中的占比目标达到10%,同时主要交通基础设施沿线非化石能源发电装机容量将超过500万千瓦。与此同时,交通运输领域绿色燃料的产能将显著提升。

rows.measure: Shenzhen: Owners of non-operational National IV medium and heavy-duty trucks will receive a subsidy of up to CNY 140 000 per vehicle for scrapping and replacing their vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 深圳:非营运的国四中重型货车车主报废并更换车辆,每辆最高可获得14万元人民币补贴。

rows.measure: Proportion of NEVs in new or updated government vehicles for public transport, rental, logistics and distribution in national pilot ecological civilisation zones and key regions for air pollution prevention and control should be no less than 80% from 2021 onwards.
rows.measure_cn: 自2021年起,国家生态文明试验区和大气污染防治重点区域内,公共交通、出租、物流配送等领域新增或更新的政府用车中新能源汽车比例不低于80%。

rows.measure: Guizhou: Proportion of new energy and clean energy-powered operating vehicles and ships to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 贵州:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的营运车辆和船舶比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Sichuan: Proportion of new energy- and clean energy-powered transport (not including motorcycles) to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 四川:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的交通运输(不含摩托车)比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Shanxi: Proportion of new energy- and clean energy-powered transport to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 山西:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的交通运输比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Proportion of new energy and clean energy-powered transport to reach around 40% by 2030, and CO2 emissions intensity of new passenger cars and commercial vehicles to fall by more than 25% and 20% respectively compared to 2020 (Plan for Carbon Peaking in the Industry Sector).
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的交通运输比例达到约40%,新乘用车和商用车二氧化碳排放强度较2020年分别下降25%和20%以上(《工业领域碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Guangxi: Proportion of new energy and clean energy-powered transport vehicles to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 广西:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的交通运输车辆比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Jilin: Proportion of new energy and clean energy-powered transport vehicles to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 吉林:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的交通运输车辆比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Guangdong: Proportion of new energy and clean energy-powered transport vehicles to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 广东:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的交通运输车辆比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Liaoning: Proportion of new energy- and clean energy-powered transport vehicles to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 辽宁:到2030年新能源和清洁能源动力的交通运输车辆比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Hunan: Proportion of transport not powered by fossil energy to reach around 40% by 2030 (Plan for Carbon Peaking).
rows.measure_cn: 湖南:到2030年非化石能源动力的交通运输比例达到约40%(《碳达峰实施方案》)。

rows.measure: Release of the plan: "Three-Year Action Plan for Doubling the Service Capacity of Electric Vehicle Charging Facilities (2025–2027)", which intends to increase the number of EVSEs to 28 million nationwide and 300 GW capacity. An earlier plan released in July contained a target for more than 100 000 high-power charging facilities by the end of 2027, while at the same time promoting innovative application of high-power charging technology.
rows.source: China, National Development and Reform Commission
rows.measure_cn: 发布《电动汽车充电设施服务能力三年倍增行动计划(2025—2027年)》,拟将全国充电设施数量增至2800万台、容量达300吉瓦。今年7月发布的早前计划提出到2027年底建成超过10万台大功率充电设施的目标,同时推动大功率充电技术的创新应用。

rows.measure: Strengthened regulation for NEV manufacturer.
rows.source: China, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
rows.measure_cn: 加强对新能源汽车制造商的监管。

rows.measure: Shanghai: Subsidies for charging point and battery swapping installations with varying rates for community or commercial projects, as well as subsidised charging for taxis.
rows.measure_cn: 上海:对充电桩和换电站建设给予补贴,社区项目和商业项目费率不同,并对出租车充电给予补贴。

rows.measure: Hunan: Subsidies provided per kW of charging installed, with greater amounts for those installed along highways; varies between regions of the province.
rows.measure_cn: 湖南:按所安装充电桩的每千瓦给予补贴,高速公路沿线安装的补贴更高;各地市标准不一。

rows.measure: Tax rebates on exports of batteries will be phased out starting April 2026. The current rebate of 9% on lithium-ion batteries will be decreased from 9% to 6% on 1 April 2026, and the rebate will be fully withdrawn 1 Jan 2027. Battery components or materials such as cathode and anode active materials, and electrolyte salt rebates rates, will be reduced from 13% to 0% in April 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 自2026年4月起逐步取消电池出口退税。目前锂离子电池9%的退税率将于2026年4月1日由9%下调至6%,并于2027年1月1日全面取消。正负极活性材料、电解质盐等电池部件或材料的退税率将于2026年4月由13%降至0%。

rows.measure: The Chinese government has formalised the legal framework for recycling new-energy vehicle (NEV) batteries, placing the primary responsibility for recovering waste power cells on automakers. Under this regulation, taking effect on 1 April 2026, NEV manufacturers are required to establish recycling service outlets commensurate with their sales volumes in the regions where they operate. Automakers are also prohibited from refusing to accept waste batteries transferred by vehicle maintenance service providers and vehicle recycling companies. The regulation also mandates the creation of a national information traceability platform and a digital ID management system for NEV batteries, aimed at strengthening oversight of power battery flows throughout their life cycle.
rows.source: China, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
rows.measure_cn: 中国政府已为新能源汽车(NEV)动力电池回收建立法律框架,将回收废旧动力电池的主体责任落实到车企。根据该法规(2026年4月1日生效),新能源汽车制造商须在其经营所在区域建立与销量相匹配的回收服务网点。车企亦不得拒绝接收由汽车维修服务商和车辆回收企业转交的废旧电池。该法规还要求建立国家信息溯源平台和新能源汽车电池数字身份管理系统,旨在加强对动力电池全生命周期流向的监管。

rows.measure: The government announced that it would provide up to CNY 80 000 for vehicle replacement and CNY 42 000 for battery replacement for e-bus models over 8 years of age.
rows.measure_cn: 政府宣布,对车龄超过8年的电动公交车型,更换车辆最高补贴8万元人民币,更换电池最高补贴4.2万元人民币。

rows.measure: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology updated the Dual Credit policy for model years 2026–2027, setting NEV credit ratios at 48% and 58%, respectively, while further tightening fleet efficiency requirements and lowering credit values as the NEV market matures. The policy links CAFC standards with NEV credit mandates, requiring automakers to generate sufficient credits through fuel-efficient vehicles or NEV production, or to purchase credits to remain compliant.
rows.source: China, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
rows.measure_cn: 工业和信息化部更新了2026—2027年款的双积分政策,将新能源汽车积分比例分别设定为48%和58%,同时随新能源汽车市场的成熟进一步收紧车队能效要求并降低积分值。该政策将企业平均燃料消耗量(CAFC)标准与新能源汽车积分要求挂钩,要求车企通过生产节油车辆或新能源汽车产生足够积分,或购买积分以保持合规。

rows.measure: Total FCEV fleet reaches around 100 000 by 2025, and around 1 million during the 2030 - 2035 period (Energy-saving and New Energy Vehicle Technology Roadmap 2.0, prepared by China Society of Automotive Engineers, not official government policy).
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年燃料电池汽车(FCEV)保有量达到约10万辆,2030—2035年期间达到约100万辆(《节能与新能源汽车技术路线图2.0》,由中国汽车工程学会编制,非官方政府政策)。

rows.measure: Trade-in grants for the purchase of commercial NEVs (including medium and heavy trucks) or vehicles with higher emission standard (above National IV), with extra benefits in case of scrapping old ICEVs running on diesel. In the case of purchase of a new vehicle without scrapping an old vehicle, the subsidy is only allocated to the purchase of NEVs.
rows.source: China, National Development and Reform Commission
rows.measure_cn: 对购买商用新能源汽车(含中重型货车)或更高排放标准(国四以上)车辆提供以旧换新补贴,若报废老旧柴油燃油车则额外受益。若购买新车而不报废旧车,补贴仅适用于购买新能源汽车。

rows.measure: Updated Lithium-ion Battery Industry Regulatory Conditions and the Lithium-ion Battery Industry Regulatory Management Measures set out specific standards on battery, cathode material, anode material, separator and electrolyte.
rows.source: China, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
rows.measure_cn: 更新的《锂离子电池行业规范条件》和《锂离子电池行业规范管理办法》对电池、正极材料、负极材料、隔膜和电解液制定了具体标准。

rows.measure_cn: 宣布设立技术进步基金。其运营首年由120亿哥伦比亚比索(COP)支持,将弥补燃油车(8000万哥伦比亚比索)与零排放汽车(约1.1亿哥伦比亚比索)之间的价差。

rows.measure_cn: 2019年第1972号法律:到2035年所有在用重型车辆100%符合欧六(Euro-VI)等效标准。

rows.measure: Minimum EV purchase quota of 30% for public service fleets by 2025.

Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration, committing to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. The Colombian government has allocated COP 12 billion (approximately USD 3 million) to subsidise the purchase of electric taxis and the installation of home charging stations for drivers during Q4 2025. This initiative aims to reduce operational costs for taxi drivers by up to 43% while working toward a long-term national goal of 54 000 electric taxis by 2036.
rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。哥伦比亚政府已拨款120亿哥伦比亚比索(约300万美元),用于在2025年第四季度补贴电动出租车的购买及为司机安装家用充电站。该举措旨在将出租车司机的运营成本降低至多43%,同时朝着到2036年保有54000辆电动出租车的长期国家目标迈进。

rows.measure: Provides tax incentives for EVs, including an income tax deduction of up to 50% of the investment value for up to 15 years, and VAT exemptions for equipment, machinery, and services required for EV projects.
rows.measure_cn: 为电动汽车提供税收激励,包括在最长15年内最高可抵扣投资额50%的所得税减免,以及电动汽车项目所需设备、机械和服务的增值税豁免。

rows.measure: Issued a fully legal framework focusing on regulation of EV imports, assembly and manufacturing, and regulated treatment of EV waste, especially batteries.

rows.measure: EUR 21.2 million budget to subsidise the purchase of ZEV. L-category (L1–L7): electric, max grant EUR 2 500. M1, M2, M3: electric or hydrogen. N1, N2, N3: electric or hydrogen. For N1 and M1, max grant EUR 2 500.

rows.measure: Grants available for alternatively fuelled trucks.

rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。到2030年该国国有部门车辆总保有量的45%实现电动化,并安装38000个充电桩。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。新电动出行补贴计划拨款450万欧元。该计划将提供约450份用于购买纯电动和混合动力汽车的补贴。

rows.measure: EUR 400 - 4 000 towards a new electric two/three-wheeler.

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of a new ZEV M2 class bus.
rows.measure_cn: 购买新的零排放M2类巴士的补贴。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of new or used EVs, can be combined with a scrappage scheme, higher rates apply to taxis, disabled persons, ZEVs, and large family cars.
rows.measure_cn: 购买新车或二手电动汽车的补贴,可与报废计划叠加,出租车、残疾人、零排放汽车和大家庭用车适用更高费率。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. 50% share of alternatively fuelled vehicles in the government (public) fleet (M1 and N1) by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。到2030年政府(公共)车队(M1和N1)中替代燃料车辆占比达50%。

rows.measure: Exemption from registration fee and road tolls for BEV, FCEV, and HEVs with CO2 emissions less than 50 grammes per km.
rows.measure_cn: 纯电动(BEV)、燃料电池(FCEV)以及二氧化碳排放低于50克/公里的混合动力(HEV)车辆免缴注册费和道路通行费。

rows.measure: Funding available for government or municipal purchases of alternatively fuelled vehicles with 80% of funding for BEV/PHEV solutions.
rows.measure_cn: 为政府或市政购买替代燃料车辆提供资金,其中80%的资金用于纯电动/插电混动(BEV/PHEV)方案。

rows.measure: Purchase incentives for ZEVs & discounted loans on BEVs, FCEVs, and charging infrastructure
rows.measure_cn: 为零排放汽车提供购置激励,并为纯电动(BEV)、燃料电池(FCEV)车辆和充电基础设施提供贴息贷款。

rows.measure: 1 million passenger LDV stock to be ZEV by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年100万辆乘用轻型车保有量实现零排放。

rows.measure: Additional financing available for charging stations for housing associations.
rows.measure_cn: 为住房协会的充电站提供额外融资。

rows.measure: Reduced registration taxes for zero- and low-emission cars, increasing gradually from 2026 to 2035. Typically, 60% discount for BEVs, and 35-50% discount for PHEVs. Aiming to reach the same registration tax as is seen on ICE.
rows.measure_cn: 为零排放和低排放汽车降低注册税,自2026年至2035年逐步提高。通常纯电动车享60%折扣,插电混动车享35%至50%折扣。目标是最终达到与燃油车相同的注册税水平。

rows.measure: Road tax for trucks will be based on CO2 emissions from 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 自2025年起卡车道路税将基于二氧化碳排放量征收。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Tax reimbursement for BEV and a reduced rate for PHEVs when purchased as company cars from 2023-2026 and tax-free charging at work.
rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。2023至2026年期间作为公司用车购买纯电动汽车享税款返还、插电混动汽车享降低税率,并在工作场所享受免税充电。

rows.measure: Urban public transport to be emission-free from 2030, starting with new sales from 2020. 75% of public buses will be low- or zero-emission by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 城市公共交通自2030年起实现零排放,自2020年起从新车销售开始。到2030年75%的公共巴士实现低排放或零排放。

rows.measure: 10% of the private car fleet being EVs by 2030; 70% by 2050 (10% and 50% for the light commercial fleet).
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年私人乘用车保有量的10%为电动汽车,2050年达70%(轻型商用车队为10%和50%)。

rows.measure: 14 000 charging stations in 2030, 150 000 by 2050.
30% of the fleet to be electric by 2030, and 100% by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年车队的30%实现电动化,2050年达100%。

rows.measure: 5% of the private motorcycle fleet (plus 20% of the public sector fleet) to be electric by 2030; 35% by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年私人摩托车保有量的5%(另加公共部门车队的20%)实现电动化;2050年达35%。

rows.measure: EV owners pay only 50% of the new car sales VAT tax and the first license plate.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车车主仅需缴纳新车销售增值税和首次车牌费的50%。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission globally by 2040. 100% of new public transport fleet to be electric by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺努力实现到2040年全球所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。到2025年新增公共交通车队100%电动化。

rows.measure: Low and zero emission vehicles are exempt from VAT. They are also exempt of import taxes, along with charging equipment.
rows.measure_cn: 低排放和零排放汽车免征增值税。它们连同充电设备一并免征进口税。

rows.measure: Eco Retirement Plan provides a scrapping bonus of up to USD 23 000 for the renewal of vehicles first sold more than 17 years ago.
rows.measure_cn: 生态退役计划为更新首次销售逾17年的车辆提供最高23000美元的报废奖励。

rows.measure: As of 2030, all vehicles that enter the service of public and commercial transportation must be battery electric vehicles (BEVs) or zero-emission vehicles (ZEVs). rows.measure_cn: 自2030年起,所有投入公共和商业运输服务的车辆必须为纯电动汽车(BEV)或零排放汽车(ZEV)。改革《国内税制法》,对纯电动汽车实施消费税豁免,并对纯电动汽车的转让和进口实行零税率。

rows.measure: Subsidies of up to EGP 50 000 (USD 993) for the first 100 000 locally produced EVs, with plans to expand the charging network to over 3 000 charging points by 2027. Increase in the market share of private EVs in Egypt to 14% by 2025, 36% by 2030, and 50% by 2040. National Automotive Development Program (AIDP) for the local manufacturing of environmentally friendly cars. Electromobility Law that promotes the use of electric and hybrid vehicles and the implementation of charging station infrastructure for these vehicles; grants import and purchase exemptions for EVs until 2032.
rows.measure_cn: 对最初的100000辆本地生产的电动汽车提供最高50000埃及镑(993美元)的补贴,并计划到2027年将充电网络扩展至3000多个充电桩。到2025年埃及私人电动汽车市场份额提高至14%,2030年达36%,2040年达50%。实施面向环保汽车本地制造的国家汽车发展计划(AIDP)。出台《电动出行法》,推广电动和混合动力汽车的使用并实施充电站基础设施建设;在2032年前给予电动汽车进口和购置豁免。

rows.measure: Scenarios include 7-20% EV sales penetration in 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 情景包括2030年电动汽车销量渗透率达7%至20%。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. 2025 directive that vehicle importers must install EV charging stations before selling vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。2025年指令规定车辆进口商必须在销售车辆前安装电动汽车充电站。

rows.measure: 500 000 EVs in the coming 10 years
rows.measure_cn: 未来10年内达到50万辆电动汽车。

rows.measure: A ban on the import of non-EVs
rows.measure_cn: 禁止进口非电动汽车。

rows.measure: Ethiopia now targets 440 000 EVs by 2030; having originally targeted the import of 148 000 electric cars and 48 555 electric buses between 2021 and 2030, the government revised these goals after surpassing them within the first 2 years.
rows.measure_cn: 埃塞俄比亚现将目标定为到2030年达到44万辆电动汽车;原定计划为2021至2030年间进口148000辆电动汽车和48555辆电动巴士,但政府在头两年内即超额完成,遂上调了这些目标。

rows.measure: EVs are not subject to import duties if locally assembled, reduced rates apply for partially and fully assembled imports. They are also exempt from VAT, surtax, and excise tax.
rows.measure_cn: 本地组装的电动汽车免征进口关税,部分组装和全散件进口适用降低税率。它们还免征增值税、附加税和消费税。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。埃塞俄比亚政府已将其对内燃机(ICE)车辆进口的禁令扩大至汽油和柴油卡车。

rows.measure: 700 000 electric car and 45 000 electric van stock by 2030 (of which at least 50% are BEVs).

rows.measure: At least 250 000 BEV, FCEV, and PHEVs by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年至少达到25万辆纯电动(BEV)、燃料电池(FCEV)和插电混动(PHEV)汽车。

rows.measure: Funding support for alternative fuel infrastructure including charging stations.
rows.measure_cn: 为包括充电站在内的替代燃料基础设施提供资金支持。

rows.measure_cn: 改革实物福利税以利好低排放车辆,车辆充电福利将不再纳税。《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。零排放汽车进口税为0%,并适用最低年度基本车辆税,另加基于车重和燃料系数的附加车辆税。

rows.measure: “Social leasing" programme enables households with a modest income to lease a new BEV. Target volume: 50 000 vehicles in 2025. 36 BEVs are available, including three with leasing offers below EUR 100/month.

rows.measure: 200 heavy commercial FCEV stock by 2023, and 800-2 000 heavy commercial FCEV stock by 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 到2023年重型商用燃料电池汽车保有量达200辆,2028年达800至2000辆。

rows.measure: 5 000 passenger and commercial LDV FCEV stock by 2023 and 20 000-50 000 by 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 到2023年乘用和商用轻型燃料电池汽车保有量达5000辆,2028年达20000至50000辆。

rows.measure: At least 50% of public buses and coaches must be low-emissions, 100% from 2025. In large towns/cities, at least 50% of buses must be very low-emission from 2022.
rows.measure_cn: 至少50%的公共巴士和长途客车须为低排放,自2025年起达100%。在大城镇/城市,自2022年起至少50%的巴士须为极低排放。

rows.measure: At least 50% of public/state LDV renewals must be low-emission vehicles, rising to 70% from 2027. For local authorities, from 2026, 37.4% of all LDV renewals must be very low-emissions.
rows.measure_cn: 至少50%的公共/国有轻型车辆更新须为低排放车辆,自2027年起升至70%。对地方政府,自2026年起所有轻型车辆更新的37.4%须为极低排放。

rows.measure: Continuation of purchase incentives for BEVs.
rows.measure_cn: 继续为纯电动汽车提供购置激励。

rows.measure: End sale of new fossil fuel LDVs by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 到2040年停止销售新的化石燃料轻型车辆。

rows.measure: End sale of new passenger cars emitting more than 123 g CO2/km by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年停止销售排放超过123克二氧化碳/公里的新乘用车。

rows.measure: Express deduction of 20-60% of the investment cost in alternatively fuelled trucks depending on vehicle size.
rows.measure_cn: 根据车辆尺寸,对替代燃料卡车的投资成本可即时抵扣20%至60%。

rows.measure: Grant of up to 40% of the cost of a new EV/FCEV truck.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买新的电动/燃料电池(EV/FCEV)卡车,补贴最高达成本的40%。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of a new BEV/FCEV, as well as used EVs and retrofits, bonuses for low-income individuals. The grants were lowered from a maximum of 7000 EUR to 4000 EUR.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买新的纯电动/燃料电池(BEV/FCEV)汽车以及二手电动汽车和改装车提供补贴,低收入个人享额外补贴。补贴上限已从7000欧元下调至4000欧元。

rows.measure: Implementation of LEZs in metropolitan agglomerations of more than 150 000 inhabitants by 31 December 2024, and provision for interest-free EV purchase loans to low-income households living in these zones.
rows.measure_cn: 在2024年12月31日前于人口超过15万的大都市区实施低排放区(LEZ),并为居住在这些区域的低收入家庭提供无息电动汽车购车贷款。

rows.measure: In 2022, companies with over 100 LDVs must include at least 10% low-emissions vehicles in their renewals, rising to 20% in 2024, 35% in 2027, and 50% by 2030 (Article 77).
rows.measure_cn: 自2022年起,拥有100辆以上轻型车辆的公司在更新车辆时须包含至少10%的低排放车辆,2024年升至20%,2027年升至35%,2030年达50%(第77条)。

rows.measure: No new sales of new HDVs assigned to the transport of people or goods and using mainly fossil fuels by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 到2040年不再销售主要使用化石燃料、用于运送人员或货物的新重型车辆。

rows.measure: Produce 2 million electric and hybrid cars domestically by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年国内生产200万辆电动和混合动力汽车。

rows.measure: Reach 400 000 public charging points by 2030, including at least 50 000 with fast charging for a total of 8 GW of public charging capacity.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年建成40万个公共充电桩,其中至少5万个具备快速充电功能,公共充电总容量达8吉瓦。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Subsidies of 30% of the cost of the installation of chargers that are made publicly available.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。对面向公众开放的充电桩安装提供30%成本的补贴。

rows.measure: Tax on the mass of passenger vehicles will include BEVs from the 1st July 2026, with extra penalties added to any electric car with a weight exceeding 2.1 tonnes (including a deduction of 600 kg compared to other cars). FCEVs are exempted from this tax.
rows.measure_cn: 乘用车质量税自2026年7月1日起将纳入纯电动汽车,对车重超过2.1吨的电动车额外加征罚款(相比其他车辆可扣除600千克)。燃料电池汽车(FCEV)免征此税。

rows.measure: Tax relief available on the installation of a home charger.
rows.measure_cn: 家用充电桩安装可享税收减免。

rows.measure: Promote low emission fuel and HEVs, introduce an age limit of a maximum of 3 years for imported vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 推广低排放燃料和混合动力汽车(HEV),对进口车辆引入最高3年的车龄限制。

rows.measure: Announced plan to modernise transport with electric buses/rail and charging corridors.
rows.measure_cn: 宣布以电动巴士/铁路和充电走廊实现交通运输现代化的计划。

rows.measure: Incentives to promote EV adoption, such as VAT exemptions and reduced import taxes for electric and hybrid vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 推动电动汽车普及的激励措施,如电动和混合动力汽车的增值税豁免及降低进口税。

rows.measure: Starting from 1 April 2026, Georgia prohibits the import, first registration and temporary registration of M1 passenger vehicles older than 6 years, whilst electric vehicles are exempt.
rows.measure_cn: 自2026年4月1日起,格鲁吉亚禁止进口、首次注册和临时注册车龄超过6年的M1类乘用车,电动汽车除外。

rows.measure: 10 year (up to 2030) exemption of vehicle taxes for commercial EVs, as well as other tax incentives for company cars, and company-facilitated EV charging for new registrations until 31/12/2025. Approximately one-third of kilometres travelled to take place on the basis of electrical drives or eFuels by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 商用电动汽车享10年(至2030年)车辆税豁免,公司用车享其他税收激励,2025年12月31日前新注册车辆享公司提供的电动汽车充电福利。到2030年约三分之一的行驶里程基于电力驱动或电子燃料(eFuels)。

rows.measure: Extends the motor vehicle tax exemption for purely electric vehicles until 2035 for vehicles registered before 2030 (providing an incentive to switch early).
rows.measure_cn: 对2030年前注册的车辆,将纯电动汽车的机动车税豁免延长至2035年(以激励尽早转换)。

rows.measure: Funding programme for hydrogen infrastructure and hydrogen trucks.
rows.measure_cn: 面向氢能基础设施和氢能卡车的资助计划。

rows.measure: Incentive programme supporting low-income households with the adoption of EVs. EUR 3 billion allocated to support around 800 000 vehicles through 2029. Up to EUR 6 000 for BEVs and EUR 4 500 for EREVs.
rows.measure_cn: 支持低收入家庭购买电动汽车的激励计划。拨款30亿欧元,在2029年前支持约80万辆车。纯电动(BEV)最高6000欧元,增程式电动(EREV)最高4500欧元。

rows.measure: Masterplan Charging Infrastructure 2030 sets a roadmap for the expansion of public and non- public charging infrastructure across all vehicle segments. The masterplan includes 41 measures including tax incentives for EVs, funding for charging, simplified implementations and permitting processes.
rows.measure_cn: 《2030充电基础设施总体规划》为各车型细分领域公共和非公共充电基础设施的扩建制定了路线图。该总体规划包括41项措施,涵盖电动汽车税收激励、充电资助、简化实施和审批流程。

rows.measure: Motor tax exemption for EVs with less than 50g CO2/km emissions or at least 60km range (80km from 2025) until 2030. Privileges for electric cars on German roads, e.g. car parking and bus lane use.
rows.measure_cn: 对二氧化碳排放低于50克/公里或续航至少60公里(2025年起为80公里)的电动汽车,在2030年前免征机动车税。电动汽车在德国道路上享有特权,例如停车和使用公交专用道。

rows.measure: On 18 December 2025, the European Commission granted state aid approval to a significant German funding programme designed to enable the rapid deployment of heavy electric commercial vehicle (e-truck) charging hubs along the national motorway network. The scheme, backed by up to EUR 1.6 billion in public support, represents a major national contribution to the build-out of alternative fuels infrastructure in Europe and supports EU climate and transport objectives. The first procurement round covers 1410 charging points at 120 locations.
rows.measure_cn: 2025年12月18日,欧盟委员会批准了德国一项重大资助计划的国家援助,该计划旨在沿国家高速公路网快速部署重型电动商用车(电动卡车)充电枢纽。该计划由最高16亿欧元公共支持作后盾,是欧洲替代燃料基础设施建设的重大国家贡献,并支持欧盟气候和交通目标。首轮采购涵盖120个站点的1410个充电桩。

rows.measure: Plan to have 15 million EVs on Germany roads by 2030
rows.measure_cn: 计划到2030年德国道路上有1500万辆电动汽车。

rows.measure: The pledge goal is 100% zero-emission LDV acquisitions of civil government owned and operated fleet, with aspirations for 100% zero-emission M/HDV acquisitions, by no later than 2035. Germany also specifically for 100% of all new or replacement vehicles to be environmentally friendly drive technologies by 2030, and by 2025 at least 50% of which will be electric drives. 4%, 16%, and 32% of cars sold to be EVs in 2025, 2030, and 2050 respectively.
rows.measure_cn: 承诺目标为不晚于2035年实现政府所有及运营车队100%零排放轻型车采购,并力争实现中重型车100%零排放采购。德国亦特别提出到2030年所有新购或更换车辆100%采用环保驱动技术,其中到2025年至少50%为电力驱动。到2025年、2030年和2050年电动汽车分别占汽车销量的4%、16%和32%。

rows.measure: 4%, 16%, and 32% of public buses sold to be EVs in 2025, 2030, and 2050 respectively.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年、2030年和2050年电动汽车分别占公共巴士销量的4%、16%和32%。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission globally by 2040. Target of 35% EVs in new vehicle sales.
rows.source: Government of the Republic of Ghana
rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署国,该备忘录目标为到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占30%,2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺努力实现到2040年全球所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。新车销售中电动汽车占比目标为35%。

rows.measure: The Ministry plans to deploy at least 100 rapid charging stations nationwide over the next 5 years, complementing the existing network of home and Level 1/2 chargers already spreading through urban centres.
rows.source: Government of the Republic of Ghana
rows.measure_cn: 该部计划在未来5年内于全国部署至少100个快速充电站,作为已在各城市中心普及的现有家用及1/2级充电桩网络的补充。

rows.measure: EVs are exempted from an emissions tax on vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车免征车辆排放税。

rows.measure: Tender for a national EVSE build‑out across key locations.
rows.measure_cn: 在各关键地点进行全国充电设施(EVSE)建设招标。

rows.measure: 50% of new registrations of passenger cars and 40% of new registrations of LCVs must be electric by 2030 (National Energy Climate Plan).
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年乘用车新注册量的50%和轻型商用车(LCV)新注册量的40%须为电动(《国家能源与气候计划》)。

rows.measure: Ensure adequate charging facilities to meet EV targets.
rows.measure_cn: 确保充足的充电设施以实现电动汽车目标。

rows.measure: From 2024, 25% of new company cars to have emissions less than 50gCO2/km from 2024. 33% of taxis and leased vehicles to be zero-emissions from 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 自2024年起,25%的新公司用车排放须低于50克二氧化碳/公里。自2026年起,33%的出租车和租赁车辆须为零排放。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of new private BEVs and taxis. These grants are also dependent on returning old cars for scrappage and the age of the BEV buyer.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买新的私人纯电动汽车(BEV)和出租车提供补贴。这些补贴还取决于报废旧车以及纯电动汽车购买者的年龄。

rows.measure: Registration tax exemption for BEVs; reduction of 75% for PHEVs; and reduction of 50% for HEVs. BEVs, PHEVs, and HEVs (>1549 cc) are exempt from annual circulation tax. BEVs and PHEVs as company vehicles are exempt from benefit-in-kind tax.
rows.measure_cn: 纯电动汽车(BEV)免征注册税;插电混动(PHEV)减免75%;混合动力(HEV)减免50%。纯电动、插电混动和混合动力(排量>1549毫升)车辆免征年度通行税。作为公司用车的纯电动和插电混动汽车免征实物福利税。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. The government increased the budget for the EV subsidy scheme by EUR 13 million, to reach EUR 57 million.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。政府将电动汽车补贴计划的预算增加1300万欧元,达到5700万欧元。

rows.measure: Full exemption of import duties and fees for EVs and EVSE. 25% duties on hybrid vehicles. Sets a non-binding objective for all new vehicle purchases from 2025 to be electric or hybrid, as set out in the 2024 Budget Statement.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车和充电设施(EVSE)进口关税及费用全额豁免。混合动力车辆征收25%关税。设定非约束性目标,即自2025年起所有新车购买为电动或混合动力,如2024年预算声明所述。

rows.measure: Law on Incentives for Electric Mobility contains several ways to promote EVs. It includes an import tax exemption or purchase tax exemption for EVs (motorcycles, trains, or trolleybuses) and an exemption on vehicle registration tax. It also containis an exemption from income tax for manufacturers of EVs, and a annual regressive exemption of the circulation tax for all EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 《电动出行激励法》包含多种推广电动汽车的方式。其中包括对电动汽车(摩托车、火车或无轨电车)的进口税豁免或购置税豁免,以及车辆注册税豁免。还包括对电动汽车制造商的所得税豁免,以及对所有电动汽车通行税的年度递减豁免。

rows.measure: Provides full tax exemptions for electric motor vehicles, applying 0% customs duty, 0% excise tax, and 0% VAT on the importation of electric LDVs to lower purchase costs and encourage market uptake.
rows.measure_cn: 为电动机动车提供全额税收豁免,对进口电动轻型车实行0%关税、0%消费税和0%增值税,以降低购车成本并鼓励市场接受。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. 20% of the fleet being electric by 2050, and 100% zero or low emission vehicles for light vehicles sales by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署国,承诺在领先市场努力实现不晚于2035年所有新乘用车和厢式货车销售实现零排放。到2050年车队的20%实现电动化,并到2050年轻型车销售100%为零排放或低排放车辆。

rows.measure: At least 50% EVs in the urban public transport sector for passengers and light cargo by 2030. Announcement of possible adoption of ZEVs for mass public transport.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年城市公共交通客运和轻型货运领域至少50%为电动汽车。宣布可能在大众公共交通中采用零排放汽车。

rows.measure: BEVs and HEVs with a electric range above 50 km are exempt from registration tax and annual circulation tax. BEVs and PHEVs as company vehicles are exempt from taxation
rows.measure_cn: 电动续航里程超过50公里的纯电动汽车和混合动力汽车免缴注册税和年度通行税。作为公司用车的纯电动汽车和插电混动汽车免税。

rows.measure: Funded programme that seeks to replace existing bus fleet with electric (BEV, FCEV, and trolley e-bus) options and encourage local production.
rows.measure_cn: 通过资金支持的项目,旨在用电动方案(纯电动、燃料电池及无轨电车)替换现有公交车队,并鼓励本地生产。

rows.measure: Grants towards the private and commercial purchase of a BEV, up to 55% of the purchase cost for taxis.
rows.measure_cn: 对私人及商业购买纯电动汽车提供补贴,出租车最高可补贴购置成本的55%。

rows.measure: As of 2020, government entities will not purchase gasoline/petrol or diesel vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 自2020年起,政府机构不再采购汽油或柴油车辆。

rows.measure: As of 2024, electric and hybrid vehicles will pay road tax per kilometre driven, this will be ISK 6 (Icelandic kronur) (USD 0.04) per km. For diesel and petrol cars this will come into effect one year later, in 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 自2024年起,电动汽车和混合动力汽车将按行驶里程缴纳道路税,税率为每公里6冰岛克朗(ISK)(0.04美元)。柴油车和汽油车将于一年后,即2025年起实施。

rows.measure: Ban sales of passenger petrol and diesel vehicles after 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 2030年后禁止销售汽油和柴油乘用车。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Starting January 1, 2026, a monthly kilometre fee must be paid for all vehicles, regardless of their energy source. The fee is determined by the vehicle's weight.
rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署方,目标是到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比达30%,到2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于在主要市场最迟到2035年实现新售汽车和厢式货车全部为零排放。自2026年1月1日起,所有车辆无论何种能源类型,均须缴纳按月计算的里程费,费用依据车辆重量确定。

rows.measure: Uttar Pradesh: 1 000 electric buses in stock by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 北方邦:到2030年保有1 000辆电动公交车。

rows.measure: West Bengal: 1 million EVs in stock across all segments by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 西孟加拉邦:到2030年各类车型电动汽车保有量达100万辆。

rows.measure: Kerala: 1 million EVs in stock by 2030 across all segments
rows.measure_cn: 喀拉拉邦:到2030年各类车型电动汽车保有量达100万辆。

rows.measure: Assam: 100 000 electric two-wheelers, 75 000 electric three-wheelers stock by 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 阿萨姆邦:到2026年保有10万辆电动两轮车、7.5万辆电动三轮车。

rows.measure: West Bengal: 100 000 public and semi-public charging stations by 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 西孟加拉邦:到2026年建成10万个公共及半公共充电站。

rows.measure: Kerala: 100% electric bus sales by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 喀拉拉邦:到2025年电动公交车销量占比达100%。

rows.measure: Madhya Pradesh: 100% electric bus sales by 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 中央邦:到2028年电动公交车销量占比达100%。

rows.measure: Andhra Pradesh: 100% electric bus sales by 2029.
rows.measure_cn: 安得拉邦:到2029年电动公交车销量占比达100%。

rows.measure: Assam: 100% electric buses sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 阿萨姆邦:到2030年电动公交车销量占比达100%。

rows.measure: Madhya Pradesh: 100% electric commercial and logistics fleet sales by 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 中央邦:到2028年商用及物流车队销量100%为电动。

rows.measure: Goa: 100% exemption from road tax and one-time registration fee for BEVs. Subsidy of 20-50% on fixed capital investment amount (variable as per industry size). Manufacturing units will receive an exemption on goods and services tax (tax payable on purchase of goods) and stamp duty (tax payable on registration of properties).
rows.measure_cn: 果阿邦:纯电动汽车100%免缴道路税和一次性注册费。对固定资本投资额提供20%-50%的补贴(依企业规模浮动)。制造企业将获得商品及服务税(购买商品时应缴的税)和印花税(房产注册时应缴的税)的减免。

rows.measure: Assam: 100% of government vehicles to be converted to EVs by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 阿萨姆邦:到2030年政府车辆100%改为电动汽车。

rows.measure: Gujarat: 110 000 electric two-wheelers, 70 000 electric three-wheelers stock by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 古吉拉特邦:到2025年保有11万辆电动两轮车、7万辆电动三轮车。

rows.measure: Manipur: 15% of sales to be EV by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 曼尼普尔邦:到2025年电动汽车销量占比达15%。
