rows.measure_cn: 古吉拉特邦:到2025年保有2万辆四轮电动汽车。

rows.measure: Assam: 25 000 electric 4Ws in stock by 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 阿萨姆邦:到2026年保有2.5万辆四轮电动汽车。

rows.measure: Maharashtra: 30% EV sales share by 2030. State-level EV incentives have been introduced to help meet this target.
rows.measure_cn: 马哈拉施特拉邦:到2030年电动汽车销量占比达30%。已推出邦级电动汽车激励措施以助实现该目标。

rows.measure: Tamil Nādu: 30% of bus stock to be electric by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 泰米尔纳德邦:到2030年公交车保有量30%为电动。

rows.measure: Karnataka: 4W mini goods vehicles, cab aggregators, corporate fleets, and school buses/vans to achieve 100% electric sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 卡纳塔克邦:四轮微型货车、网约车聚合平台、企业车队及校车/校车厢式车到2030年实现100%电动销售。

rows.measure: Tamil Nādu: 750 charging stations to be incentivised under the State EV policy.
rows.measure_cn: 泰米尔纳德邦:依据邦电动汽车政策对750个充电站提供激励。

rows.measure: Odisha: BEVs to account for 20% of total vehicle sales by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 奥迪沙邦:到2025年纯电动汽车占车辆总销量的20%。

rows.measure: Assam: BEVs to make up 25% of all vehicle registrations by 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 阿萨姆邦:到2026年纯电动汽车占全部车辆注册量的25%。

rows.measure: Bureau of Energy Efficiency has shared a draft of future corporate average fuel economy (CAFE) III and IV standards for light-duty passenger vehicles with relevant stakeholders to seek their comments. The proposed standards cover model years 2027–2032 and 2032–2037, respectively, and target CO2 emissions of 91.7 g CO2/km and 70 g CO2 /km as measured over the WLTC (reaching MIDC fuel economy of 3.014 l/100km by 2032).
rows.measure_cn: 能效局已向相关利益方分享未来轻型乘用车企业平均燃油经济性(CAFE)第三、第四阶段标准草案以征求意见。拟议标准分别覆盖2027-2032和2032-2037车型年,目标为在WLTC工况下测得的二氧化碳排放分别达91.7 g CO2/km和70 g CO2/km(到2032年实现MIDC燃油经济性3.014 l/100km)。

rows.measure: Funding for charging infrastructure.
rows.measure_cn: 对充电基础设施提供资金支持。

rows.measure: National Electric Bus Programme - Ambitious National Electric Bus Program (NEBP) launched in 2022, aiming to deploy an additional 50 000 electric buses over 5 years.
rows.measure_cn: 国家电动公交车计划——2022年启动的雄心勃勃的国家电动公交车计划(NEBP),旨在5年内增配5万辆电动公交车。

rows.measure: Passenger vehicles older than 20 years and commercial vehicles older than 15 years must pass a “fitness and emissions test” to retain their registration; incentives to scrap old vehicles, including discounts on the purchase of new vehicles against a scrappage certificate.
rows.measure_cn: 车龄超过20年的乘用车和超过15年的商用车须通过"适驶性与排放检测"方可保留注册;对报废旧车提供激励,包括凭报废证书购置新车享受折扣。

rows.measure: PM e-Bus Sewa-Payment Security Mechanism (PSM) Scheme: Rs. 3,435.33 crore (USD 412 million) to support the deployment of more than 38,000 electric buses in the country.
rows.measure_cn: PM e-Bus Sewa支付保障机制(PSM)方案:投入34.3533亿卢比(4.12亿美元)支持在全国部署超过38 000辆电动公交车。

rows.measure: PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE) Scheme is a USD 1.3 billion scheme to provide purchase incentives for e-2Ws, e-3Ws, e-ambulances, e-trucks and other new emerging EV categories. However, the terminal date for e-2Ws has been extended to 2026 July, while for some e-3Ws it has been retained at 2026 March.
rows.measure_cn: PM创新车辆提升电动驱动革命(PM E-DRIVE)方案是一项13亿美元的计划,为电动两轮车、电动三轮车、电动救护车、电动卡车及其他新兴电动汽车类别提供购置激励。其中,电动两轮车的截止期已延至2026年7月,部分电动三轮车仍保留为2026年3月。

rows.measure: PM e-Truck Incentive Scheme: INR 9.6 lakh per vehicle (USD 11 000) to support the deployment of 5 600 e-Trucks in the country, of which 1 100 in Delhi. The incentive is available for vehicles with a GVW above 3.5 tonnes.
rows.measure_cn: PM电动卡车激励方案:每辆车96万卢比(1.1万美元),支持在全国部署5 600辆电动卡车,其中1 100辆在德里。该激励适用于总重超过3.5吨的车辆。

rows.measure: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Advanced Cell Chemistry manufacturing in India.
rows.measure_cn: 印度先进电芯化学制造生产关联激励(PLI)方案。

rows.measure: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry. USD 3.1 billion as financial incentives to promote domestic manufacturing and draw investments into the value chain of the automotive manufacturing industry.
rows.measure_cn: 汽车及汽车零部件产业生产关联激励(PLI)方案。提供31亿美元财政激励,以促进本土制造并吸引投资进入汽车制造业价值链。

rows.measure: Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Electric Passenger Cars in India (SMEC). Carmakers committing to setup e-4W manufacturing facilities in India within 3 years, and to achieve 50% domestic value addition within 5 years, will be allowed to import a limited amount of electric cars manufactured by them with reduced import duties.
rows.measure_cn: 印度电动乘用车制造促进方案(SMEC)。承诺在3年内于印度建立四轮电动汽车制造工厂、并在5年内实现50%本土增加值的车企,将获准以降低的进口关税进口一定数量其自产的电动汽车。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission globally by 2040. The Bureau of Energy Efficiency has shared a draft of future corporate average fuel economy (CAFE) I standards for light-duty commercial vehicles, medium freight trucks and heavy freight trucks. The proposed standards cover model years 2027–2032 and target CO2 emissions of 115 g CO2/km for LCVs as measured over the Modified Indian Driving Cycle (MIDC), and a 30% fuel economy improvement for heavy-duty trucks by 2032.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于到2040年全球新售汽车和厢式货车全部为零排放。能效局已分享未来轻型商用车、中型货运卡车和重型货运卡车企业平均燃油经济性(CAFE)第一阶段标准草案。拟议标准覆盖2027-2032车型年,目标为轻型商用车在改进型印度驾驶循环(MIDC)下测得的二氧化碳排放达115 g CO2/km,并到2032年实现重型卡车燃油经济性提升30%。

rows.measure: The revised EV charging guidelines set maximum time periods for EV charger electricity connection by location type, and limit the tariff for electricity supply to EV charging stations as not exceeding the average cost of supply until 31 March 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 修订后的电动汽车充电指南按地点类型规定了电动汽车充电桩接电的最长时限,并限定向电动汽车充电站的供电电价在2028年3月31日前不超过平均供电成本。

rows.measure: Karnataka: Three-wheeler sales to achieve 100% electric mobility by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 卡纳塔克邦:三轮车到2030年实现100%电动出行销售。

rows.measure: Draft Battery Swapping Policy document that outlines definitions and conditions for support of battery swapping station subsidies and rollout.
rows.measure_cn: 换电政策文件草案,概述了换电站补贴及推广支持的定义与条件。

rows.measure: 2 million passenger EV stock and 13 million electric motorcycle stock by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年乘用电动汽车保有量达200万辆,电动摩托车保有量达1 300万辆。

rows.measure: Import duty and tax exemptions for carmakers producing locally until the end of 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 对在本地生产的车企给予进口关税和税收减免,有效期至2026年底。

rows.measure: Number of charging stations (SPKLU) set to reach over 60 000 units by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年充电站(SPKLU)数量将超过60 000个。

rows.measure: Presidential instruction Indonesia requires government offices to procure and use EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 印度尼西亚总统指令要求政府部门采购并使用电动汽车。

rows.measure: Production targets of 10% of 1.5 million cars to be electric in 2020, 20% out of 2 million units in 2025, 25% out of 3 million in 2030 and 30% out of 4 million in 2035.
Production targets of 10% of 8 million two-wheeler units to be electric in 2020, 20% of 10 million units in 2025, 25% of 12.5 million in 2030 and 30% of 15 million in 2035.
Set the maximum allowable electricity tariff multiplier (of 1.5), which applies to electricity sold to EV drivers at public charging stations.
rows.measure_cn: 设定最高允许电价倍率(1.5倍),适用于在公共充电站向电动汽车驾驶者出售的电力。

rows.measure: Tax incentive scheme to reduce the upfront price of electric LDVs and buses, conditional on meeting local-content threshold.
rows.measure_cn: 税收激励方案,以降低电动轻型车和公交车的购置前期价格,前提是满足本地含量门槛。

rows.measure: 30% of stock, and 100% of sales passenger LDV sales to be EVs by 2030 (2023 reiteration of 100% sales target and formalisation of 30% stock target, ca. 950 000).
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年乘用轻型车30%的保有量、100%的销量为电动汽车(2023年重申100%销量目标并正式确立约95万辆的30%保有量目标)。

rows.measure: 35% ZEV share of HDV registrations by 2030, with an interim target of 700 units by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年重型车注册量中零排放汽车占比达35%,2025年中期目标为700辆。

rows.measure: Grants for BEV public service vehicles, including bonuses for the scrappage of older more polluting vehicles with high mileage.
rows.measure_cn: 对纯电动公共服务车辆提供补贴,包括对报废高里程、高污染旧车的奖励。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of passenger and LCV BEVs.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买纯电动乘用车和轻型商用车提供补贴。

rows.measure: Grants up to 60% of the price difference between the diesel equivalent and the BEV, PHEV, or FCEV model available for the purchase of HDVs.
rows.measure_cn: 购买重型车时,对柴油同款与纯电动、插电混动或燃料电池车型之间的差价最高补贴60%。

rows.measure: No new diesel buses from 2019, ambition for all urban buses to be low emission by 2035, with 300 and 1 500 electric buses by 2025 and 2030 respectively.
rows.measure_cn: 自2019年起不再购置新柴油公交车,目标到2035年所有城市公交车实现低排放,2025年和2030年分别拥有300辆和1 500辆电动公交车。

rows.measure: Reduced toll and motor tax for low emissions vehicles, Value Related Tax (VRT) relief, exemption from Benefit-in-Kind taxes, and Accelerated Capital Allowance.
rows.measure_cn: 对低排放车辆减免通行费和机动车税、提供购置注册税(VRT)减免、免缴实物福利税(Benefit-in-Kind),并提供加速资本折旧(Accelerated Capital Allowance)。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Various grants and funding schemes in place to support infrastructure development, aiming for at least 11 HDV charging pools to be installed by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署方,目标是到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比达30%,到2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于在主要市场最迟到2035年实现新售汽车和厢式货车全部为零排放。已设立多项补贴和资助方案支持基础设施建设,目标到2025年至少建成11个重型车充电集群。

rows.measure: All new fuel stations are required to include at least one EV charger.
rows.source: Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran
rows.measure_cn: 所有新建加油站须配备至少一个电动汽车充电桩。

rows.measure: Locally manufactured EVs are exempted from VAT, and the renewal of the public transport fleet with hybrid vehicles and EVs is incentivised, for example through lower import tariffs.
rows.source: Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran
rows.measure_cn: 本地生产的电动汽车免缴增值税,并对以混合动力车和电动汽车更新公共交通车队提供激励,例如降低进口关税。

rows.measure: 5% share of private vehicles sold in 2022 to be EVs, 23% by 2025 and 61% by 2028, with 100% to be EVs by 2030.
Ban on all non-EV or non-CNG vehicles after 2030, leading to 1.4 million EV sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 2030年后禁止所有非电动或非压缩天然气(CNG)车辆,从而到2030年实现140万辆电动汽车销量。

rows.measure: By 2025, all new municipal buses will be electric, with grants in place to help achieve this.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年,所有新购市政公交车均为电动,并设立补贴以助实现。

rows.measure: EV purchase tax rates (currently 10% but to increase to 20%) are lower than ICE purchases taxes (83%); for plug-in hybrid vehicles (PHEVs), purchase taxes are set to increase from 40% to 55%.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车购置税率(目前为10%,但将提高至20%)低于燃油车购置税(83%);插电混动汽车(PHEV)的购置税将从40%提高至55%。

rows.measure: National Action Plan on Climate Change: Increase stock share of zero-emission urban buses to 50% by 2036 and 100% by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 国家气候变化行动计划:到2036年将零排放城市公交车保有量占比提高至50%,到2050年达100%。

rows.measure: National Action Plan on Climate Change: Target to reduce average emissions from new LDVs by 95% by 2030 relative to 2020, and by 100% in 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 国家气候变化行动计划:目标是到2030年将新售轻型车平均排放相对2020年降低95%,2050年降低100%。

rows.measure: Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. The pledge goal is 100% zero-emission LDV acquisitions of civil government owned and operated fleet, with aspirations for 100% zero-emission M/HDV acquisitions, by no later than 2035. Israel also specifically aims for all new government passenger vehicles from 2022 to be hybrid, and all electric from 2025. 30% of the purchase price (up to EUR 3 000) for BEV and PHEV two/three-wheelers. Up to 40% (EUR 4 000) if a Euro 0-3 bike is scrapped.
rows.measure_cn: 《中重型车辆零排放谅解备忘录》签署方,目标是到2030年中重型车辆零排放汽车销量占比达30%,到2040年达100%。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于在主要市场最迟到2035年实现新售汽车和厢式货车全部为零排放。承诺目标为最迟到2035年政府自有及运营车队100%采购零排放轻型车,并力争100%采购零排放中重型车。以色列还特别力争自2022年起所有新购政府乘用车为混合动力,自2025年起全部为电动。对纯电动和插电混动两轮/三轮车补贴购置价的30%(最高3 000欧元)。若报废一辆欧0-3排放标准的车辆,补贴最高可达40%(4 000欧元)。

rows.measure: 6 million passenger electric LDV stock (including 4 million BEVs by 2030).
rows.measure_cn: 乘用电动轻型车保有量达600万辆(其中到2030年纯电动达400万辆)。

rows.measure: 85% share of EVs and hybrids in all public HDV purchases by 2030; 30% by 2022 and 50% by 2025 (includes methane and hydrogen in some cases).
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年所有公共重型车采购中电动汽车和混合动力车占比达85%;2022年达30%,2025年达50%(在某些情况下包括甲烷和氢能)。

rows.measure: 85% share of EVs and hybrids in all public LDV by 2030; 30% by 2022 and 50% by 2025 (includes methane and hydrogen in some cases).
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年所有公共轻型车采购中电动汽车和混合动力车占比达85%;2022年达30%,2025年达50%(在某些情况下包括甲烷和氢能)。

rows.measure: EUR 597.3 million in funding to be used until mid-2026, with a target of replacing around 39 000 internal-combustion vehicles with BEVs. Private individuals can receive up to EUR 11 000 (depending on the applicant's economic situation, 'ISEE'). Small businesses (micro-enterprises) may obtain up to EUR 20 000 per vehicle, corresponding to 30% of the purchase price of a new electric light-commercial vehicle (categories N1–N2).
rows.measure_cn: 提供5.973亿欧元资金,使用至2026年中期,目标是用纯电动汽车替换约39 000辆内燃机车辆。私人个体最高可获1.1万欧元(取决于申请人的经济状况指标'ISEE')。小型企业(微型企业)每辆车最高可获2万欧元,相当于新购电动轻型商用车(N1-N2类别)购置价的30%。

rows.measure: Multiple: EVs and CNG/LPG cars are exempt from annual ownership tax for 5 years from purchase, and receive a 75% discount on this tax relative to petrol cars from purchase onwards, though exact benefits vary by region.
rows.measure_cn: 多项:电动汽车和压缩天然气/液化石油气汽车自购置起5年免缴年度拥有税,自购置起相对汽油车享受该税75%的折扣,但具体优惠因地区而异。

rows.measure: Grants available towards the purchase of EV trucks.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买电动卡车提供补贴。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of a new BEV, lower amount for PHEVs, with an additional scrappage bonus available.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买新纯电动汽车提供补贴,插电混动车补贴额较低,并附加报废奖励。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of electric LCVs.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买电动轻型商用车提供补贴。

rows.measure: Phase out new ICE cars by 2035 and LCVs by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 到2035年逐步淘汰新燃油乘用车,到2040年淘汰新燃油轻型商用车。

rows.measure: Subsidy in the form of tax relief for installing home chargers.
rows.measure_cn: 以税收减免形式对安装家用充电桩提供补贴。

rows.measure: Vehicle tax of car companies increases to 50% for ICEVs, while is reduced to 10% for BEVs and 20% for PHEVs
rows.measure_cn: 汽车公司的车辆税:燃油车提高至50%,纯电动汽车降至10%,插电混动汽车降至20%。

rows.measure: Reduction of import duties for EVs that are 3 years old or less, from 30% to 10%, and exemption from the license fee for 5 years. In 2025, a proposal was made for an amendment to increase the import and purchase tax for high-end vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 对车龄不超过3年的电动汽车下调进口关税,由30%降至10%,并免缴牌照费5年。2025年提出一项修订提案,拟提高高端车辆的进口及购置税。

rows.measure: 100% of passenger car sales to be electrified vehicles (BEV, PHEV, HEV, or FCEV) by 2035, 20- 30% of LCV sales to be electrified vehicles by 2030, and electrified vehicles and decarbonised fuel vehicles to account for 100% of sales by 2040 (Green Growth Strategy).
rows.measure_cn: 到2035年乘用车销量100%为电动化车辆(纯电动、插电混动、混合动力或燃料电池);到2030年轻型商用车销量20%-30%为电动化车辆;到2040年电动化车辆及脱碳燃料车辆占销量的100%(绿色增长战略)。

rows.measure: 20-30% share of BEVs and PHEVs, 30-40% share of HEVs and 3% share of FCEVs in passenger LDV sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年乘用轻型车销量中纯电动和插电混动占20%-30%、混合动力占30%-40%、燃料电池占3%。

rows.measure: 300 000 charging ports including 30 000 public fast chargers (and 1 000 hydrogen stations) by 2030 (10 times more than in 2023).
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年建成30万个充电端口,包括3万个公共快充桩(以及1 000个加氢站)(为2023年的10倍)。

rows.measure: Aiming for an advanced introduction of 5 000 electrified M/HDVs in the 2020s.
rows.measure_cn: 力争在2020年代提前引入5 000辆电动化中重型车。

rows.measure: Aims to promote software defined vehicles (SDVs) in all powertrains and to account for 30% of global SDV sales in 2030. The Japanese government also announced stock targets for Japanese manufacturers equivalent to 30% of global SDV sales by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 旨在推动各类动力总成的软件定义汽车(SDV),并力争在2030年占全球SDV销量的30%。日本政府还宣布日本制造商到2035年的保有量目标相当于全球SDV销量的30%。

rows.measure: Fuel economy standard: 25.4 km/L for passenger LDVs by 2030, equivalent to a 32.4% improvement compared to 2016 and includes EVs. Well-to-wheel approach adopted that includes grid electricity energy consumption for EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 燃油经济性标准:到2030年乘用轻型车达25.4 km/L,相当于较2016年提升32.4%,并包括电动汽车。采用井到轮(Well-to-wheel)方法,计入电动汽车的电网电力能耗。

rows.measure: Fuel economy standard: 6.52 or 7.63 km/L (JH25) by 2025 (depending on vehicle class and weight) for heavy commercial vehicles. Target to reduce fuel consumption by 13.4-14.3% compared to 2015 standard.
rows.measure_cn: 燃油经济性标准:到2025年重型商用车达6.52或7.63 km/L(JH25)(依车型级别和重量而定)。目标是相对2015年标准将燃油消耗降低13.4%-14.3%。

rows.measure: Purchase subsidies for passenger cars.
rows.measure_cn: 对乘用车提供购置补贴。

rows.measure: Purchase subsidies for vans and trucks for commercial use.
rows.measure_cn: 对商用厢式货车和卡车提供购置补贴。

rows.measure: Tokyo: Subsidies for selected 2/3Ws to reach goal of 100% of new 2/3Ws being petrol-free by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 东京:对选定的两轮/三轮车提供补贴,以实现到2035年新售两轮/三轮车100%无汽油的目标。

rows.measure: The Jordanian government has approved a new graduated mechanism for calculating the special tax on EVs, set to be applied over 3 years, from 2025 to 2027. The decision replaces the previously planned immediate application of the tax starting 1 January 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 约旦政府已批准一项对电动汽车特别税的分级累进计算机制,将于2025年至2027年的3年内分阶段实施。该决定取代了此前计划自2025年1月1日起立即征税的安排。

rows.measure: Roadmap for EV Infrastructure: Aim to create the infrastructure necessary for electric cars in all big cities throughout the country by 2029.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车基础设施路线图:目标是到2029年在全国所有大城市建成电动汽车所需的基础设施。

rows.measure: Support the local manufacturing of EVs, including tax incentives and subsidies for EV producers.
rows.measure_cn: 支持电动汽车本地制造,包括对电动汽车生产商提供税收激励和补贴。

rows.measure: The Eurasian Economic Commission's Council has agreed on duty-free EV imports until the end of 2025 until quotas are reached.
rows.measure_cn: 欧亚经济委员会理事会已同意在配额用尽前对电动汽车实行免关税进口,有效期至2025年底。

rows.measure: 5% share of electric/hybrid vehicles in total vehicles imported by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年电动/混合动力车辆占进口车辆总量的5%。

rows.measure: Kenya aims to deliver 1 000 EVs annually to police officers, gradually ensuring that every officer at a specific level receives a vehicle.
rows.measure_cn: 肯尼亚计划每年向警务人员交付1 000辆电动汽车,逐步确保某一级别的每位警员都配备一辆车。

rows.measure: Kenya Power, the leading electricity provider in Kenya, has unveiled plans to invest a substantial sum of up to KES 258 million (Kenyan Shillings) (USD 1.9 million) over the span of 3 years to bolster the adoption of EVs throughout the country.
rows.measure_cn: 肯尼亚电力公司(肯尼亚主要电力供应商)已公布计划,将在3年内投资最高2.58亿肯尼亚先令(KES)(190万美元)以推动全国电动汽车的普及。

rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车充电基础设施(EVs-CI)监管框架,包括采用国际电动汽车标准。

rows.measure: 20% 4W (i.e. bus and taxi) public passenger vehicle sales, 60% by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 公共载客车辆(即客车和出租车等四轮车)销量的20%,至2030年达60%。

rows.measure: 25% share of EVs in private passenger vehicle sales (including two-wheelers) by 2025, and 90% by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2025年电动汽车在私人乘用车销量(含两轮车)中占25%,至2030年达90%。

rows.measure: National master plan to deploy public EV charging stations along 80 national highways under a phased rollout, typically spaced every 25–100km. Identifies 424 sites for charging station deployment.
rows.measure_cn: 沿80条国家公路分阶段部署公共电动汽车充电站的国家总体规划,通常每25-100公里设一处。确定了424处充电站部署选址。

rows.measure: Extends current tax regime, with EV customs duties ranging from 15–80% and excise duties from 5–50%. Includes reduced customs duty of 1% on EVSE. 100% of public urban bus sales to be ZEV by 2025 and 100% ZEV stock by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 延续现行税制,电动汽车关税为15-80%、消费税为5-50%。包含对充电设施(EVSE)征收1%的优惠关税。至2025年城市公交新车销售100%为零排放汽车(ZEV),至2030年保有量100%为零排放。

rows.measure: 100% ZEV share of car sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年乘用车销量100%为零排放汽车(ZEV)。

rows.measure: 15 000 FCEV passenger car stock by 2025, 300 000 by 2030; 100% ZEV share of taxi sales by 2025 in large cities, extended to the whole country by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2025年燃料电池(FCEV)乘用车保有量1.5万辆,至2030年30万辆;至2025年大城市出租车销量100%为零排放汽车(ZEV),至2030年扩展至全国。

rows.measure: 3 000 heavy-duty FCEV by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 至2025年重型燃料电池车(FCEV)3000辆。

rows.measure: EUR 14.5 million budget in 2026 to subsidise up to 20% of eligible costs for companies and organisations installing publicly accessible charging infrastructure capable of serving heavy EVs, such as trucks and buses.
rows.measure_cn: 2026年安排1450万欧元预算,为安装可服务于卡车、客车等重型电动汽车的公众可及充电基础设施的企业和机构补贴最高20%的合格成本。

rows.measure: Noord-Holland: Plans for a transition to emission-free mobility for all traffic by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 北荷兰省(Noord-Holland):计划至2030年实现所有交通向零排放出行转型。

rows.measure: Registration and motor tax exemptions for ZEVs, and reduced rates for low emission vehicles. Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Subsidy encouraging businesses and organisations to acquire fully emission-free touring coaches. Subsidy caps depend on company size. EUR 12.3 million budget.
rows.measure_cn: 对零排放汽车(ZEV)免征注册税和机动车税,对低排放车辆减免税率。《中型和重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署方,该备忘录设定中重型车至2030年零排放汽车销量占30%、至2040年100%的目标。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于推动领先市场最迟至2035年实现新乘用车和厢式货车销售全部为零排放。鼓励企业和机构购置全零排放旅游大巴的补贴,补贴上限取决于企业规模,预算1230万欧元。

rows.measure: Subsidy encouraging companies to acquire new zero-emission trucks. Percentage of the price covered depends on the company size and the vehicle category. EUR 78 million budget, with EUR 115 200 as the maximum subsidy.
rows.measure_cn: 鼓励企业购置新零排放卡车的补贴,所覆盖的价格比例取决于企业规模和车辆类别。预算7800万欧元,单车最高补贴11.52万欧元。

rows.measure: The pledge goal is 100% zero-emission LDV acquisitions of civil government owned and operated fleet, with aspirations for 100% zero-emission M/HDV acquisitions, by no later than 2035. The Private Charging Infrastructure at Companies Subsidy Scheme (SPRILA) for installing charging infrastructure for electric work or vehicles on companies' sites. EUR 87.5 million budget still to be discussed by the Dutch Senate.
rows.measure_cn: 承诺目标为政府所有及运营车队最迟至2035年实现轻型车采购100%零排放,并力争重型车采购100%零排放。《企业私人充电基础设施补贴方案》(SPRILA),用于在企业场地安装电动工作车辆或车辆的充电基础设施,预算8750万欧元,仍待荷兰参议院审议。

rows.measure: The truck toll in the Netherlands starts on 1 July 2026. From that date, truck owners will pay per kilometre driven. The cleaner and lighter the vehicle, the lower the rate per kilometre. When the charge takes effect, the Eurovignette will no longer be used in the Netherlands and motor vehicle tax will go down to the minimum.
rows.measure_cn: 荷兰卡车收费自2026年7月1日起实施。届时卡车车主将按行驶里程付费。车辆越清洁、越轻,每公里费率越低。该收费生效后,荷兰将不再使用欧洲通行证(Eurovignette),机动车税将降至最低水平。

rows.measure: Zero Emission Zones to be introduced or expanded in several Dutch municipalities. These essentially apply to vans and trucks but can also apply to company cars.
rows.measure_cn: 荷兰多个市镇将引入或扩大零排放区。这些区域主要适用于厢式货车和卡车,但也可适用于公司用车。

rows.measure: 100% of sales of urban buses to be ZEVs by 2025 and 100% of stock by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 至2025年城市公交销量100%为零排放汽车(ZEV),至2035年保有量100%。

rows.measure: Aiming for a network of 10 000 public charging points by 2030 (54th parliament Coalition agreement).
rows.measure_cn: 目标为至2030年建成1万个公共充电桩网络(第54届议会联合协议)。

rows.measure: Comprehensive EV charging strategy including a target for a charging hub every 150-200km on main highways by 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 全面的电动汽车充电战略,包括至2028年主要公路每150-200公里设一处充电枢纽的目标。

rows.measure: Electric vehicles with a gross laden weight of more than 3500 kg are exempt from road user charges
rows.measure_cn: 总载重超过3500公斤的电动汽车免征道路使用费。

rows.measure: Low Emissions Heavy Vehicle Fund (LEHVF) of USD 27.75 million towards offsetting the purchase price of low- and zero-emissions heavy vehicles. The LEHVF will contribute up to 25% of the cost of new zero- and low-emissions heavy vehicles, and up to 25% of the cost to convert existing higher-emitting heavy vehicles to be powered by low-emissions technology.
rows.measure_cn: 低排放重型车辆基金(LEHVF)2775万美元,用于抵减低排放和零排放重型车辆的购置价格。该基金将为新的零排放和低排放重型车辆贡献最高25%的成本,并为将现有高排放重型车辆改造为低排放技术驱动贡献最高25%的成本。

rows.measure: Nationwide coverage of fast/rapid direct current charging stations every 75 km across state highways.
rows.measure_cn: 在州际公路沿线每75公里设置快速/急速直流充电站,实现全国覆盖。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030 and 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. The Clean Vehicle Standard sets ambitious targets (and imposes financial penalties for non- compliance) for vehicle distributors to reduce average emissions to 65 grammes of CO2/km for passenger cars and 131 grammes for LCVs for vehicles entering New Zealand by 2029. Revenues generated are used to provide rebates on BEVs and PHEVs.
rows.measure_cn: 《中型和重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署方,该备忘录设定中重型车至2030年零排放汽车销量占30%、至2040年100%的目标。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于推动领先市场最迟至2035年实现新乘用车和厢式货车销售全部为零排放。《清洁车辆标准》(Clean Vehicle Standard)为车辆经销商设定了雄心勃勃的目标(并对不合规处以经济处罚),要求至2029年进入新西兰的乘用车平均排放降至65克CO2/km、轻型商用车(LCV)降至131克。所产生的收入用于为纯电动(BEV)和插电混动(PHEV)提供返利。

rows.measure: The pledge goal is 100% zero-emission LDV acquisitions of civil government owned and operated fleet, with aspirations for 100% zero-emission M/HDV acquisitions, by no later than 2035. The government is providing interest-free loans of NZL 52.7 million (New Zealand dollars) to two companies to boost the number of electric vehicle public chargers around the country. The zero- interest loans will go to ChargeNet and Meridian Energy, who are investing NZL 60 million in capital, and would see 2574 new charge points, 1374 DC fast chargers and 1200 AC chargers.
rows.measure_cn: 承诺目标为政府所有及运营车队最迟至2035年实现轻型车采购100%零排放,并力争重型车采购100%零排放。政府向两家公司提供5270万新西兰元的无息贷款,以增加全国电动汽车公共充电桩数量。该零息贷款将发放给ChargeNet和Meridian Energy,两家公司投入6000万新西兰元资本,预计将新增2574个充电桩,其中1374个直流快充和1200个交流充电桩。

rows.measure: EVs are exempt from import customs duty, selective consumption tax, and value added tax.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车免征进口关税、选择性消费税和增值税。

rows.measure: Exempts EVSE stations and components from import duty (DAI), selective consumption tax (ISC) and value‑added tax (VAT) under reforms to Law No. 554 (Energy Stability Law), applicable for the 2022–2027 period.
rows.measure_cn: 根据对第554号法律(《能源稳定法》)的修订,对充电设施(EVSE)充电站及组件免征进口关税(DAI)、选择性消费税(ISC)和增值税(VAT),适用于2022-2027年期间。

rows.measure: 10 year tax holiday for EV manufacturers.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动汽车制造商给予10年免税期。

rows.measure: 100% transition to EV by 2060 with interim targets of 1% EV and 2% HEV by 2030, and 60% EV and 20% HEV by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 至2060年100%转向电动汽车,阶段性目标为至2030年电动汽车1%、混合动力(HEV)2%,至2050年电动汽车60%、混合动力20%。

rows.measure: Nigerian Automotive Industry Development Plan (NADIP) aims to boost local production of vehicles (40% local content target) and promote EVs (30% locally produced vehicles to be electric) by 2032, with incentives including reduced import duties and tax incentives for manufacturers.
rows.measure_cn: 《尼日利亚汽车工业发展计划》(NADIP)旨在至2032年提升本地车辆生产(本地化率目标40%)并推广电动汽车(本地生产车辆中30%为电动),配套激励措施包括降低进口关税和为制造商提供税收优惠。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission globally by 2040. The proposed Electric Vehicle Transition and Green Mobility Bill (2025) targets domestic manufacturing with the goal of 30% local production of EVs sold in the country. Includes a clause for an NGN 500 million penalty per shipment for unlicenced importers.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于推动全球范围内最迟至2040年实现新乘用车和厢式货车销售全部为零排放。拟议的《2025年电动汽车转型与绿色出行法案》以本土制造为目标,力求国内销售电动汽车的30%实现本地生产。包含对无证进口商每批货物处以5亿奈拉(NGN)罚款的条款。

rows.measure: Vehicle finance scheme aiming to facilitate the adoption of 45 000 passenger cars and 50 000 commercial vehicles per annum.
rows.measure_cn: 车辆融资方案,旨在推动每年4.5万辆乘用车和5万辆商用车的采用。

rows.measure: On 1 January 2020, North Macedonia introduced a new tax to promote fuel economy for passenger vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 2020年1月1日,北马其顿引入一项新税以促进乘用车的燃油经济性。

rows.measure: All new city buses to be zero-emission or biogas by 2025, 75% ZEV inter-city buses by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2025年所有城市公交新车为零排放或生物燃气,至2030年城际客车75%为零排放汽车(ZEV)。

rows.measure: All new LDV sales to be zero-emission by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 至2025年所有轻型车新车销售为零排放。

rows.measure: All new medium-duty and 50% of heavy-duty vehicles to be zero-emission by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年所有中型车新车及50%的重型车为零排放。

rows.measure: EV VAT exemption continues, but threshold reduced from NOK 500 000 to NOK 300 000 in 2026. The threshold will fall to NOK 150 000 in 2027, before full removal in 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车增值税(VAT)豁免继续,但门槛于2026年由50万挪威克朗(NOK)降至30万。该门槛将于2027年降至15万,并于2028年完全取消。

rows.measure: Goods distribution in the biggest city centres to be virtually zero-emissions by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年最大城市中心的货物配送基本实现零排放。

rows.measure: Oslo: Oslo aims to be the first transport emissions-free city in Europe through a series of ultra low-emission zones. They will also stop the sale of new fossil fuel cars later in the decade, aiming to have all cars zero-emission by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 奥斯陆:奥斯陆通过一系列超低排放区力争成为欧洲首个交通零排放城市。其还将在本十年晚些时候停止销售新的化石燃料汽车,力求至2030年所有汽车实现零排放。

rows.measure: Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. The pledge goal is 100% zero-emission LDV acquisitions of civil government owned and operated fleet, with aspirations for 100% zero-emission M/HDV acquisitions, by no later than 2035. Norway specifically aims for all new LDVs to be ZEVs, and that all new city buses are ZEV or biogas by 2025, as well as 75% of new heavy vans and long-distance buses, and 50% of new lorries being ZEV by 2030. VAT (25%) exemption for BEVs below NOK 500 000 (€ 44 000) price (Introduced in 2023)​.
rows.measure_cn: 《中型和重型零排放车辆备忘录》,设定中重型车至2030年零排放汽车销量占30%、至2040年100%的目标。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于推动领先市场最迟至2035年实现新乘用车和厢式货车销售全部为零排放。承诺目标为政府所有及运营车队最迟至2035年实现轻型车采购100%零排放,并力争重型车采购100%零排放。挪威具体目标为所有轻型车新车为零排放汽车(ZEV),至2025年所有城市公交新车为零排放或生物燃气,以及至2030年75%的新重型厢式货车和长途客车、50%的新货车为零排放。对价格低于50万挪威克朗(NOK,约4.4万欧元)的纯电动汽车(BEV)免征增值税(25%)(2023年引入)。

rows.measure: It will be mandatory for all fuel stations (new and existing) to install EV chargers by 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 至2026年所有加油站(新建和现有)必须强制安装电动汽车充电桩。

rows.measure: 30% share of EVs in LDV sales by 2030, and 90% by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年电动汽车在轻型车销量中占30%,至2040年达90%。

rows.measure: Government of Pakistan officially launches National Electric Vehicle (NEV) Policy 2025–30. The policy targets 30% of new sales of bikes, rickshaws, passenger cars, light commercial vehicles, buses and trucks to be NEVs by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 巴基斯坦政府正式发布《2025-30年国家电动汽车(NEV)政策》。该政策的目标是至2030年摩托车、人力三轮车、乘用车、轻型商用车、客车和卡车的新车销量30%为新能源汽车(NEV)。

rows.measure: 30% share of EVs in truck sales by 2030, and 90% by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年电动汽车在卡车销量中占30%,至2040年达90%。

rows.measure: 50% share of bus sales to be EV by 2030, and 90% by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年客车销量的50%为电动汽车,至2040年达90%。

rows.measure: 50% share of EVs in two/three-wheeler sales by 2030, and 90% by 2040.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年电动汽车在两轮/三轮车销量中占50%,至2040年达90%。

rows.measure: Changes to tax codes to promote local manufacturing and export potential of EVs, EV parts, and charging equipment.
rows.measure_cn: 修改税法以促进电动汽车、电动汽车零部件和充电设备的本地制造及出口潜力。

rows.measure: New Energy Vehicle (NEV) Policy, aimed at transitioning 30% of vehicles stock in Pakistan to electric by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 《新能源汽车(NEV)政策》,旨在至2030年使巴基斯坦30%的车辆保有量转向电动。

rows.measure: Reduces customs duties to as low as 1% on EV and EVSE imports. Includes incentives for domestic manufacturing of EV and EVSE.
rows.measure_cn: 将电动汽车和充电设施(EVSE)进口关税降至低至1%。包含对电动汽车和充电设施本土制造的激励措施。

rows.measure: Transition of public transport to EV: 10% by 2025, 20% by 2027, and 33% by 2030.
Transition of selected public entity vehicles and transport solutions to EV: 10% by 2025, 25% by 2027, 40% by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 指定公共实体车辆及运输方案向电动转型:2025年10%,2027年25%,2030年40%。

rows.measure: 15% share of EVs in all new vehicle sales by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年电动汽车在所有新车销量中占15%。

rows.measure: Range of subsidies for a limited number of charger installations, commercial vehicles and cars.
rows.measure_cn: 对有限数量的充电桩安装、商用车和乘用车提供一系列补贴。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission globally by 2040. Establishes EVSE deployment regulation framework under Supreme Decree No. 036‑2023‑EM.
rows.measure_cn: 《中型和重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署方,该备忘录设定中重型车至2030年零排放汽车销量占30%、至2040年100%的目标。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于推动全球范围内最迟至2040年实现新乘用车和厢式货车销售全部为零排放。根据第036-2023-EM号最高法令建立充电设施(EVSE)部署监管框架。

rows.measure: A tax incentive programme has been expanded to electric 2/3Ws, HEV and PHEV cars until 2028 to improve the affordability of EVs for consumers.
rows.measure_cn: 税收激励方案已扩展至电动两轮/三轮车、混合动力(HEV)和插电混动(PHEV)乘用车,持续至2028年,以提升电动汽车对消费者的可负担性。

rows.measure: Deployment of 600, almost 1 200, and almost 1 800 new BEVs over the period up to 2028, to 2034, and to 2040, respectively, in the Business as Usual case. In the Clean Energy Scenario these figures are over 2 200, almost 1 500, and over 1 600.
rows.measure_cn: 在常规情景下,至2028年、2034年和2040年期间分别部署600辆、近1200辆和近1800辆新纯电动汽车(BEV)。在清洁能源情景下,这些数字分别为逾2200辆、近1500辆和逾1600辆。

rows.measure: Deployment of almost 110 000, almost 200 000, and almost 300 000 new EVs over the period up to 2028, to 2034, and to 2040, respectively, in the Business as Usual case. In the Clean Energy Scenario these figures are over 550 000, almost 650 000, and over 850 000 and a greater share of early adoption is HEVs, with later adoption predominately BEVs.
rows.measure_cn: 在常规情景下,至2028年、2034年和2040年期间分别部署近11万辆、近20万辆和近30万辆新电动汽车。在清洁能源情景下,这些数字分别为逾55万辆、近65万辆和逾85万辆,且早期采用更多为混合动力(HEV),后期采用以纯电动(BEV)为主。

rows.measure: Deployment of over 200 000, almost 400 000, and over 550 000 new EVs over the period up to 2028, to 2034, and to 2040, respectively, in the Business as Usual case. In the Clean Energy Scenario these figures are almost 1.9 million, over 1.2 million, and almost 1.2 million.
rows.measure_cn: 在常规情景下,至2028年、2034年和2040年期间分别部署逾20万辆、近40万辆和逾55万辆新电动汽车。在清洁能源情景下,这些数字分别为近190万辆、逾120万辆和近120万辆。

rows.measure: All battery electric vehicles are exempted from import duties until 2028.
rows.measure_cn: 所有纯电动汽车(BEV)免征进口关税,持续至2028年。

rows.measure: Electric Vehicle Industry Development Act (EVIDA) provides fiscal and non-fiscal incentives to support e-mobility including tax exemptions, and also governs the manufacturing, assembly, importation, construction, installation, maintenance, trade and utilisation, research and development and regulation of EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 《电动汽车产业发展法》(EVIDA)提供财政和非财政激励以支持电动出行,包括税收豁免,并对电动汽车的制造、组装、进口、建造、安装、维护、贸易与使用、研发及监管加以规范。

rows.measure: Hybrids pay 50% of the excise tax and BEVs are exempt (TRAIN Law - RA 10963)
rows.measure_cn: 混合动力车缴纳50%的消费税,纯电动汽车(BEV)免征(TRAIN法 - RA 10963)。

rows.measure: 600 000 EVs and hybrids by 2030, with an ambition of up to 1 million by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年电动汽车及混合动力车60万辆,并力争至2025年达到100万辆。

rows.measure: Additional subsidies specifically for the purchase of EVs and chargers by the country's national parks.
rows.measure_cn: 专为本国国家公园购买电动汽车和充电桩提供的额外补贴。

rows.measure: Grant available equal to 30-50% of the eligible costs depending on power rating.
rows.measure_cn: 可获得相当于合格成本30-50%的补贴,具体取决于功率等级。

rows.measure: Grant of 80-90% of eligible costs of the purchase or lease of an electric bus (BEV/FCEV/e- Trolley), and 50% of the infrastructure cost.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买或租赁电动客车(纯电动BEV/燃料电池FCEV/电动无轨电车)提供合格成本80-90%的补贴,以及50%的基础设施成本补贴。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of ZEVs, with higher amounts available depending on vehicle size, commercial use, and annual mileage.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买零排放汽车(ZEV)提供补贴,补贴金额视车辆尺寸、商用用途和年行驶里程而提高。

rows.measure: In cities of more than 100 000 people, ZEVs to make up 100% of new public transport purchases by 2025, and 100% of all public transport vehicles by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 在人口超过10万的城市,至2025年零排放汽车(ZEV)占公共交通新采购的100%,至2030年占所有公共交通车辆的100%。

rows.measure: Installation of 49 000 slow and 11 000 fast charging points by 2030, with an ambition for as many as 85 000 and 15 000 respectively.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年安装4.9万个慢速和1.1万个快速充电桩,并力争分别达到8.5万个和1.5万个。

rows.measure: Local governments have to ensure at least a 30% share of ZEVs in their LDV fleets by 2025, as well as 30% ZEV (or biomethane) buses in public transport services from 2028. Central government central LDV fleet target is 50% by 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 地方政府须至2025年确保其轻型车队中零排放汽车(ZEV)占比至少30%,并自2028年起公共交通服务中30%的客车为零排放(或生物甲烷)。中央政府中央轻型车队目标为至2025年达50%。

rows.measure: NaszEauto: PLN 1.6 billion budget supports private individuals and sole traders in acquiring new electric passenger vehicles (M1 category).
rows.measure_cn: NaszEauto:16亿兹罗提(PLN)预算,支持个人和个体经营者购置新的电动乘用车(M1类)。

rows.measure: Programme for charging Infrastructure for Heavy-Duty Transport. Distribution system operators (DSOs) are eligible to apply for grants covering up to 100% of eligible investment costs. The call will remain open until 31 December 2025 with a budget of PLN 1 billion for the first round.
rows.measure_cn: 重型运输充电基础设施计划。配电系统运营商(DSO)有资格申请覆盖最高100%合格投资成本的补贴。征集将持续至2025年12月31日,第一轮预算为10亿兹罗提(PLN)。

rows.measure: Programme for Charging Stations for Heavy Vehicles. Targets entrepreneurs and aims to fund the development of 550 publicly accessible charging stations for zero-emission trucks. Funding can reach up to 100% of eligible costs for standard projects. Applications are open until 31 August 2025, with PLN 1 billion allocated for the current round.
rows.measure_cn: 重型车辆充电站计划。面向企业,旨在资助建设550个面向零排放卡车的公众可及充电站。标准项目资助可达合格成本的100%。申请截至2025年8月31日,本轮拨款10亿兹罗提(PLN)。

rows.measure: Registration tax exemption for BEVs and FCEVs; registration tax exemption for PHEVs until 2029.
rows.measure_cn: 对纯电动汽车(BEV)和燃料电池车(FCEV)免征注册税;对插电混动(PHEV)的注册税豁免持续至2029年。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. 30% EV share of car sales by 2030, 100% by 2050. Diesel to no longer be cost effective by 2030, petrol by 2040, in both cases replaced by EVs.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于推动领先市场最迟至2035年实现新乘用车和厢式货车销售全部为零排放。至2030年电动汽车占乘用车销量30%,至2050年100%。柴油车至2030年、汽油车至2040年不再具成本效益,两者均由电动汽车取代。

rows.measure: BEVs are exempt from payment of vehicle and road tax, reduction of 75% for PHEVs, and 40% for HEVs.
rows.measure_cn: 纯电动汽车(BEV)免缴车辆税和道路税,插电混动(PHEV)减免75%,混合动力(HEV)减免40%。

rows.measure: Grants available for the installation cost plus up to 80% of the cost of a home charger.
rows.measure_cn: 可获得安装成本补贴,外加家用充电桩成本最高80%的补贴。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of private BEVs, with higher amounts available for BEV LCVs.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买私人纯电动汽车(BEV)提供补贴,纯电动轻型商用车(LCV)补贴金额更高。

rows.measure: Hydrogen and electricity to account for almost 100% of heavy duty transport by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 至2050年氢能和电力占重型运输的近100%。

rows.measure: Plans to convert 35% of car fleet and 100% of public buses to electric by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 计划至2030年将35%的汽车保有量和100%的公共客车转为电动。

rows.measure: The Multi-Modal Transport Strategy 2030 aims for a 20% adoption rate—not solely among newly registered vehicles, but across all registered vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 《2030年多式联运战略》力求实现20%的采用率——不仅限于新注册车辆,而是涵盖所有已注册车辆。

rows.measure: Introduces a road tax regime for electric vehicles under the Tax Code of the Republic of Moldova (Codul fiscal nr. 1163‑XIII), applicable from 2026, establishing differentiated road‑use taxation rules for vehicles with electric motors, including electric cars and two‑wheelers.
rows.measure_cn: 根据《摩尔多瓦共和国税法典》(Codul fiscal nr. 1163-XIII)引入电动汽车道路税制度,自2026年起适用,为配备电动机的车辆(包括电动汽车和两轮车)制定差异化的道路使用征税规则。

rows.measure: 600 000 charging stations, 40 000 of which are fast or semi-fast.
rows.measure_cn: 60万个充电站,其中4万个为快速或半快速充电。

rows.measure: 700 000 BEV and P/HEVs by 2030
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年70万辆纯电动汽车(BEV)和插电/混合动力车(P/HEV)。

rows.measure: Grants towards the purchase of a BEV, lower amounts for a PHEVs, with mandatory scrappage of one car, and various bonuses available as well as tax incentives.
rows.measure_cn: 对购买纯电动汽车(BEV)提供补贴,插电混动(PHEV)金额较低,须强制报废一辆汽车,并提供各类奖励及税收激励。

rows.measure: At least 9 400 and 2 900 standard and fast charging stations by 2024, and 72 000 and 28 000 respectively by 2030, and up to 144 000 in more ambitious scenarios.
rows.measure_cn: 至2024年至少建成9400个标准充电站和2900个快速充电站,至2030年分别达到7.2万个和2.8万个,在更宏伟的情景下最高达14.4万个。

rows.measure: Electric vehicles were granted a temporary exemption from tolls on federal toll roads under a government experiment launched on 1 March 2023.
rows.measure_cn: 根据2023年3月1日启动的政府试验,电动汽车获准在联邦收费公路上临时免缴通行费。

rows.measure: EV Development Concept (2021): State funding for the development of a battery industry, including production of the raw materials.
rows.measure_cn: 《电动汽车发展构想》(2021):为电池产业发展(包括原材料生产)提供国家资金支持。

rows.measure: EV Development Concept (2021): The government introduced concessional loans and leasing programs to encourage EV purchases. Related policy that I cannot confirm is: Russia introduced financial incentives for EV buyers, including subsidized leasing and state support for up to 25% of the cost of domestically produced electric cars (Government Order No. 2633-р).
rows.measure_cn: 《电动汽车发展构想》(2021):政府推出优惠贷款和租赁方案以鼓励电动汽车购买。无法确认的相关政策为:俄罗斯为电动汽车买家引入财政激励,包括补贴租赁和对国产电动汽车成本最高25%的国家支持(政府第2633-р号命令)。

rows.measure: Scenarios (3) envisage a 5-30% share of new sales by 2030, meaning 0.5 - 3.2 million EVs on the road by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 三种情景设想至2030年新车销量占比为5-30%,意味着至2030年路上有50万至320万辆电动汽车。

rows.measure: Preferential lending programme for fast-charging hubs. The preferential rate is equivalent to 8% per annum for a term of up to 5 years.
rows.measure_cn: 面向快速充电枢纽的优惠贷款计划。优惠利率相当于年化8%,期限最长5年。

rows.measure: Russia allocates RUS 5.7 billion (Russian rubles) to subsidise the purchase of electric vehicle charging equipment.
rows.measure_cn: 俄罗斯拨款57亿卢布(RUS)补贴电动汽车充电设备的购买。

rows.measure: Introduction of a carbon tax, establishment of restricted zones for green transport, and further preferential treatment for EVs.
rows.measure_cn: 引入碳税,设立绿色交通限制区,并对电动汽车给予进一步优惠待遇。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission globally by 2040. Tariffs at charging stations are capped at industrial rates, with lower off-peak tariffs; provision of charging stations including planning codes.
rows.measure_cn: COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于推动全球范围内最迟至2040年实现新乘用车和厢式货车销售全部为零排放。充电站电价上限设为工业电价,非高峰时段电价更低;提供充电站建设,包括规划规范。

rows.measure: The Rwandan government has passed regulations prohibiting the registration of ICE e-moto taxis in Kigali, effective January 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 卢旺达政府已通过法规,禁止在基加利注册燃油摩托出租车,自2025年1月起生效。

rows.measure: VAT, withholding tax, and import duty exemptions for EVs and associated parts/equipment.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动汽车及相关零部件/设备免征增值税(VAT)、预扣税和进口关税。

rows.measure: The Cabinet of Ministers approved Saint Lucia's NDC 3.0 in February 2025. It sets a target to achieve 30% electric vehicle sales by 2030, increasing to 40% by 2035. It also enhances the 2030 target to a 14.7% reduction in energy sector emissions by 2030, relative to 2010, achieved through 40% renewable energy penetration from a mix of solar and wind plus battery storage, increased energy efficiency, and electric vehicle uptake. This supersedes the previous NDC 2.0 target of 7% GHG reduction and should be reflected as the most current announced national target.
rows.measure_cn: 部长内阁于2025年2月批准了圣卢西亚的NDC 3.0。其设定了至2030年实现电动汽车销量30%、至2035年提升至40%的目标。它还将2030年目标提升为相对2010年能源部门排放减少14.7%,通过太阳能与风能加电池储能组合实现40%可再生能源渗透、提升能效及电动汽车采用来达成。这取代了此前NDC 2.0中温室气体减排7%的目标,应作为最新公布的国家目标予以体现。

rows.measure: Saint Lucia's 2023–2030 National Energy Policy sets an aggressive 50% renewable energy target by 2030 and aims to make hybrid and electric vehicles a significant part of the national fleet, with a 33% EV/hybrid penetration target by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 圣卢西亚《2023-2030年国家能源政策》设定了至2030年50%可再生能源的激进目标,并力求使混合动力和电动汽车成为国家车队的重要组成部分,目标为至2030年电动/混合动力渗透率33%。

rows.measure: Saint Lucia's national electricity provider LUCELEC launched its first public EV charging network in December 2024, with 8 charger units across 4 locations island-wide (Rodney Bay, Dennery, Soufrière, Vieux-Fort). This represents the first operational public charging infrastructure deployment measure.
rows.measure_cn: 圣卢西亚国家电力供应商LUCELEC于2024年12月推出其首个公共电动汽车充电网络,在岛内4个地点(Rodney Bay、Dennery、Soufrière、Vieux-Fort)设有8个充电单元。这代表着首个投入运营的公共充电基础设施部署措施。

rows.measure: Accelerate the introduction of electric mobility in Saint Lucia through capacity-building and electric vehicle demonstration and prepare it for scaling-up and replication through the development of electric mobility policies, business models and finance schemes. The UNEP Global Electric Mobility Programme is actively supporting Saint Lucia with the introduction of electric light-duty vehicles and charging infrastructure, as part of a 25-country programme backed by GEF funding. Work includes support from the Global Thematic Working Groups on Electric LDVs and on Charging Infrastructure, Batteries and Grid Integration, hosted by the IEA. The Public Investment Fund (PIF) has a goal to produce 500 000 EVs annually by 2030, up from a target of 150 000 in 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 通过能力建设和电动汽车示范加速圣卢西亚电动出行的引入,并通过制定电动出行政策、商业模式和融资方案为其扩大规模和复制做好准备。UNEP全球电动出行计划正积极支持圣卢西亚引入电动轻型车和充电基础设施,该计划为GEF资金支持的25国计划的一部分。工作内容包括由IEA主办的电动轻型车及充电基础设施、电池与电网集成全球专题工作组的支持。公共投资基金(PIF)的目标是至2030年每年生产50万辆电动汽车,高于2026年15万辆的目标。

rows.measure: The Saudi CAFE standard sets fuel economy targets for light-duty vehicles up to 2028. The ranges are as follows: 2024: 15.7-21.0 km/L; 2025: 16.0-21.4 km/L; 2026: 16.9-22.6 km/L; 2027: 17.7-23.7 km/L; 2028: 18.5-24.8 km/L.

Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Senegal has the ambition to have >15% penetration of EVs in new vehicle registrations by 2030, and aims by 2030 to have 37 000 EVs in the national fleet and 3 700 charging points available.
rows.measure_cn: 《中型和重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署方,该备忘录设定中重型车至2030年零排放汽车销量占30%、至2040年100%的目标。塞内加尔力求至2030年电动汽车在新车注册中渗透率超过15%,并力争至2030年国家车队拥有3.7万辆电动汽车和3700个充电桩。

rows.measure: Total exemption of import duties on EVs, VAT on EVs, registration frees. Corporate tax exemptions for companies that manufacture or assemble EVs and EV charging stations.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动汽车进口关税、电动汽车增值税(VAT)、注册费全额豁免。对制造或组装电动汽车及电动汽车充电站的企业给予企业税豁免。

rows.measure: MoU between European Union and Serbia on sustainable raw materials, batteries and EVs. Serbia plans to have a total of 164 EV chargers installed along its motorways by April 2025, with one at every 6.2 kilometres by April 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 欧盟与塞尔维亚关于可持续原材料、电池和电动汽车的谅解备忘录(MoU)。塞尔维亚计划至2025年4月在其高速公路沿线共安装164个电动汽车充电桩,实现至2025年4月每6.2公里设一个。

rows.measure: The government allocated around USD 1.6 million (RSD 170 million ) for new electric vehicle purchase subsidies in 2024–2026.
rows.measure_cn: 政府在2024-2026年拨款约160万美元(1.7亿塞尔维亚第纳尔RSD)用于新的电动汽车购置补贴。

rows.measure: 100% of public bus stock to be electric by 2050.
rows.measure_cn: 至2050年公共客车保有量100%为电动。

rows.measure: 30% of new private vehicle sales to be electric by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年新私人车辆销量的30%为电动。

rows.measure: On 17 September 2025, The Ministry of Transport and the Seychelles Public Transport Corporation (SPTC) signed a contract with Ashok Leyland in India for the procurement of 14 new electric buses.
rows.measure_cn: 2025年9月17日,交通部和塞舌尔公共交通公司(SPTC)与印度Ashok Leyland签订合同,采购14辆新电动客车。

rows.measure: Targets 17% EV sales share in Sierra Leone by 2030; 33% by 2033; and 42% by 2035.
rows.measure_cn: 目标为至2030年塞拉利昂电动汽车销量占比17%;至2033年33%;至2035年42%。

rows.measure: All new buses since 2020 are EV or hybrid, with the aim of phasing out all existing diesel buses by 2040 (100% of stock to be EV by 2040).
rows.measure_cn: 自2020年起所有新客车均为电动或混合动力,旨在至2040年淘汰所有现有柴油客车(至2040年保有量100%为电动)。

rows.measure: Deploy 60 000 EV charging points by 2030, 40 000 in public car parks and 20 000 in private premises.
rows.measure_cn: 至2030年部署6万个电动汽车充电桩,其中4万个在公共停车场,2万个在私人场所。

rows.measure: Electric Vehicle Early Adoption Incentive (EEAI) scheme: registration tax rebates for electric vehicle owners.
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车早期采用激励(EEAI)方案:为电动汽车车主提供注册税返利。

rows.measure: Enhanced Commercial Vehicle Emissions (CVES) and Early Turnover Schemes (ETS) which provides incentives and discounted registration costs to owners replacing their older more polluting vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 强化版商用车排放(CVES)和提前置换(ETS)方案,为更换其较旧、污染更重车辆的车主提供激励和注册费折扣。

rows.measure: No new diesel car or taxi registrations from 2025, and all new registrations to be EV, PHEV, or FCEV by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 自2025年起不再注册新柴油乘用车或出租车,至2030年所有新注册车辆为电动汽车、插电混动(PHEV)或燃料电池车(FCEV)。

rows.measure: Suite of rebates, reduced registration costs, and lower taxes applied to EVs and petrol hybrids.
rows.measure_cn: 对电动汽车和汽油混合动力车适用一系列返利、降低注册费和减税措施。

rows.measure: Vehicular Emission Scheme (VES): registration tax rebates based on a vehicles' CO2 emissions plus emissions of four other local pollutants.
rows.measure_cn: 车辆排放方案(VES):基于车辆CO2排放及另外四种本地污染物排放的注册税返利。

rows.measure: Signatory of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Zero-Emission Medium- and Heavy- Duty Vehicles, which targets 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Grants available for BEVs and PHEVs. In addition to cars, light-commercial vehicles/vans up to 3.5 tonnes also qualify. The subsidy programme operates on a first-come, first-served basis, with both EVs and PHEVs covered by the same subsidy pool; the application process occurs when and where the vehicles are purchased; there are no vehicle price restrictions.
rows.measure_cn: 《中型和重型零排放车辆谅解备忘录(MOU)》签署方,该备忘录设定中重型车至2030年零排放汽车销量占30%、至2040年100%的目标。对纯电动汽车(BEV)和插电混动(PHEV)提供补贴。除乘用车外,3.5吨以下的轻型商用车/厢式货车也符合资格。该补贴计划按先到先得原则运作,纯电动汽车和插电混动共用同一补贴池;申请流程在车辆购买时和购买地点进行;无车价限制。

rows.measure: Registration tax and road tax benefits for BEVs and PHEVs
rows.measure_cn: 对纯电动汽车(BEV)和插电混动(PHEV)给予注册税和道路税优惠。

rows.measure: Slovak Republic automotive EV action plan includes financial measures to support EVs and EVSE and legislative measures in the areas of taxation and infrastructure, among other measures.
rows.measure_cn: 斯洛伐克汽车业电动汽车行动计划包含支持电动汽车和充电设施的财政措施,以及税收、基础设施等领域的立法措施。

rows.measure: Grant towards the purchase of a new BEV.
rows.measure_cn: 购买新纯电动汽车提供补助。

rows.measure: No new sales of LDVs with CO2 emissions above 100 g CO2/km by 2025, and 50 g CO2/km by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年不再新销售CO2排放高于100 g CO2/km的轻型车,到2030年提高至50 g CO2/km。

rows.measure: Registration tax reduction for BEVs
rows.measure_cn: 对纯电动汽车减免注册税。

rows.measure: Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Subsidies for Electric Vehicle Purchase. rows.measure: Electrifying 100% of the central government fleet by 2027, ahead of the original 2030 target.

rows.measure_cn: 美国联邦公路管理局提议修改电动汽车充电器的《购买美国货要求豁免》,将获得公路项目联邦援助的电动汽车充电器在美国制造的部件成本门槛从充电器部件总成本的55%提高至100%。

rows.measure: USD 6 billion grant programme, including USD 3 billion to fund the domestic production of materials needed for the EV supply chain, including the refining of nickel, lithium and cobalt, as well as rare earth metals (Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act).
rows.measure_cn: 60亿美元补助计划,其中30亿美元用于资助电动汽车供应链所需材料的国内生产,包括镍、锂、钴的精炼以及稀土金属(《基础设施投资与就业法案》)。

rows.measure: 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Full exemption from the Specific Internal Tax (IMESI = 0%) for EVs to support the adoption of electric mobility. In addition, the legislation grants a full exemption from the Global Tariff Rate (TGA = 0%) on the import of EVs, lithium batteries, and charging equipment. Signatory to COP26 ZEV Declaration to work towards all sales of new cars and vans being zero emission by no later than 2035 in leading markets. Exemptions and/or reductions of various taxes and duties for EVs and EV parts up to 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年中重型车零排放汽车销售份额达30%,到2040年达100%。对电动汽车完全豁免特定国内税(IMESI = 0%)以支持电动出行的普及。此外,立法对进口电动汽车、锂电池和充电设备完全豁免全球关税税率(TGA = 0%)。COP26零排放汽车宣言签署方,致力于在领先市场推动到不晚于2035年所有新售乘用车和厢式货车实现零排放。对电动汽车及电动汽车零部件减免各类税费至2030年。

rows.measure: Uzbekistan sets target for 10% of cars to be electric by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 乌兹别克斯坦设定目标,到2030年汽车的10%为电动。

rows.measure: Ban on the sale and use of motor fuels with an environmental class lower than the Euro-4 standard by the end of 2025.
rows.measure_cn: 到2025年底禁止销售和使用环保等级低于欧4标准的机动车燃料。

rows.measure: State programme including preferential loans for EVs of up to 16%.
rows.measure_cn: 国家计划,包括为电动汽车提供最高16%的优惠贷款。

rows.measure: Decree No. 57/2020/ND-CP: Encourage the production of environmentally friendly vehicles (fuel- saving cars, HEVs, vehicles using biofuels, EVs), meeting the requirements of emission standards according to the approved roadmap. In addition, to support the development of the country’s automobile industry, 0% preferential import tax rates will be levied on raw materials and components used for automobile manufacturing and assembly that has not yet been domestically made, from 2020 to 2024.
rows.measure_cn: 第57/2020/ND-CP号法令:鼓励生产环保车辆(节油汽车、混合动力汽车、使用生物燃料的车辆、电动汽车),按已批准的路线图满足排放标准要求。此外,为支持国家汽车工业发展,2020至2024年间对尚未国产的汽车制造和组装所用原材料及部件征收0%优惠进口税率。

rows.measure: Electricity used for EV charging and battery-swap cabinets gets dedicated tariffs: lower at off- peak times, moderately higher at normal hours and significantly higher for peak-hour charging.
rows.measure_cn: 用于电动汽车充电和换电柜的电力实行专门电价:谷时较低、平时适度较高、峰时显著较高。

rows.measure: First-time registration fee for battery electric car is held at 0% until 28 February 2027 (Government Decree 51/2025/ND-CP).
rows.measure_cn: 纯电动汽车的首次注册费维持0%至2027年2月28日(政府第51/2025/ND-CP号法令)。

rows.measure: Ho Chi Minh City will ban fossil-fuel 2/3W for ride-hailing and delivery services from 2026.
rows.measure_cn: 胡志明市自2026年起禁止燃油两/三轮车用于网约和配送服务。

rows.measure: Net zero greenhouse gas emissions in the transport sector by 2050, with a goal of 100% of road transport using electricity and green energy.
rows.measure_cn: 到2050年交通部门实现温室气体净零排放,目标为道路交通100%使用电力和绿色能源。

rows.measure: Reduced excise tax for BEV cars and buses up to 24 passengers and LCVs (from 15% current tax rate), rates reduced to 2-3% (depending on model), to increase to 11% after 2027.
rows.measure_cn: 对纯电动汽车及载客不超过24人的客车和轻型商用车(LCV)降低消费税(从当前15%税率),税率降至2-3%(视车型而定),2027年后提高至11%。

rows.measure: Special consumption tax policy for electric vehicles
rows.measure_cn: 电动汽车特别消费税政策。

rows.measure: The city of Hanoi will gradually ban fossil-fuel motorcycles and mopeds. From July 2026, coventional models will be banned on Ring Road 1, ban extension to Ring Road 3 will be completed by 2030.
rows.measure_cn: 河内市将逐步禁止燃油摩托车和助力车。自2026年7月起,传统车型将在一环路被禁,到2030年前完成对三环路的禁令扩展。

rows.measure: 30% ZEV sales in M/HDVs by 2030, 100% by 2040. Guidelines for electric vehicle charging pricing methodology.
rows.measure_cn: 到2030年中重型车零排放汽车销售份额达30%,到2040年达100%。电动汽车充电定价方法指南。

rows.measure: Reduction of gasoline and diesel demand by ICE vehicles through the uptake of electric and hydrogen vehicles.
rows.measure_cn: 通过推广电动和氢能车辆减少燃油车对汽油和柴油的需求。
